satya.en: AI is the future of the firm: every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
satya.zh: AI 不是一项技术，而是企业的未来：每家企业都必须构建自己的爬坡机器，以复利式积累 token 资本。

satya.en: Private evals may be the biggest IP, letting firms hill-climb on frontier models without leaking traces.
satya.zh: 私有评估可能成为最大的知识产权，让企业在前沿模型上爬坡而不泄露痕迹。

satya.en: The platform promise is enabling every company to operate at the frontier with its own intelligence.
satya.zh: 平台的承诺，是让每家公司都能用自己的智能在前沿上运作。

satya.en: Microsoft aims to be a frontier ecosystem, not just a frontier model; agent era expands TAM orders of magnitude.
satya.zh: 微软要做的是前沿生态，而不只是前沿模型；智能体时代将把 TAM 扩大数个数量级。

satya.en: Scaling laws work, but alignment is not arriving as a natural outcome; anthropomorphizing AI may prevent alignment.
satya.zh: 缩放定律有效，但对齐并不会自然到来；把 AI 拟人化可能反而阻碍对齐。

aaronlevie.en: Application companies are the hottest neolabs; the bridge from model to enterprise workflow is vast and requires lots of software.
aaronlevie.zh: 应用公司才是最炙手可热的新实验室；从模型到企业工作流之间的桥梁极其宽广，需要大量软件来搭建。

aaronlevie.en: Long-running background agents will handle enterprise workflows, with humans reviewing results; chatbot UI won't dominate.
aaronlevie.zh: 长时间运行的后台智能体将处理企业工作流，人类只负责审核结果；聊天机器人界面不会主导一切。

aaronlevie.en: Open-weight models will grow exponentially as mature use cases get peeled off to cheaper models.
aaronlevie.zh: 随着成熟用例被剥离到更便宜的模型上，开放权重模型将呈指数级增长。

aaronlevie.en: AI diffusion into non-coding knowledge work will take much longer than Silicon Valley expects; coding diffused fast because code is pure text.
aaronlevie.zh: AI 向非编程知识工作的扩散会比硅谷预期慢得多；编程扩散得快，是因为代码是纯文本。

aaronlevie.en: Frontier labs must build safely with governance, security, and alignment; pacing is orthogonal to security and a fuzzy nonword.
aaronlevie.zh: 前沿模型实验室必须通过治理、安全和 对齐 来安全地构建；节奏控制与安全正交，是个模糊的非词。

thariq.en: Capability overhang: models are smarter than our harnesses let them show; harness engineering means deleting old scaffolding as models improve.
thariq.zh: 能力过剩：模型比现有工具链所能发挥的更聪明；工具链工程的关键是随模型进步不断删掉旧脚手架。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative human-agent dialogue, not a static spec; smarter models need leaner prompts and separate verification agents.
thariq.zh: 规划是持续的人机对话而非静态文档；模型越聪明，提示越精简，并需独立的验证智能体来减少自指偏差。

thariq.en: Evals are art more than science for novel problems; founders should iterate fast without heavy evals in zero-to-one work.
thariq.zh: 对全新问题，评估更像艺术而非科学；创始人在从零到一阶段应快速迭代，而非过早堆砌重型评估。

thariq.en: RAG may be an anti-pattern for context search; graph-based approaches and models building their own context are preferable.
thariq.zh: RAG 在上下文检索上可能已成反模式；基于图的方法、让模型自建上下文更可取，超大上下文窗口并非必需。

thariq.en: Prompting is the meta-skill; spend upfront context and compute, scale effort with task complexity, and pace the frontier.
thariq.zh: 提示是元技能；应前置投入上下文与算力，按任务复杂度调节投入，并把前沿节奏当作每个工程师都应理解的技术问题。

diogoalmeida.en: Scaling laws work because data and task are right, not just compute; the bitter lesson is wrong.
diogoalmeida.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）与缩放定律之所以有效，是因为数据和任务选对了，而不只是算力堆得多；「苦涩的教训」是错的。

diogoalmeida.en: RLHF makes models mode-drop; safety alignment fractures intelligence and is misaligned with users.
diogoalmeida.zh: 基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）会让模型模式崩塌；安全对齐与用户利益错位，并割裂了智能本身。

diogoalmeida.en: Reliability, not speed or cost, makes AI trustworthy; robustness beats determinism as the north star.
diogoalmeida.zh: 让 AI 值得信赖的是可靠性，而非速度或成本；作为北极星指标，鲁棒性比确定性更重要。

diogoalmeida.en: AI should be a database-like utility in software; refusals are a type error in APIs.
diogoalmeida.zh: AI 应像数据库一样作为软件中的基础公用设施；API 拒绝请求是一种类型错误。

diogoalmeida.en: Automate easy, economically valuable tasks first; coding agents are assistance, not automation, and may worsen quality.
diogoalmeida.zh: 应先自动化简单且有经济价值的任务；编程智能体只是辅助而非自动化，甚至可能因监督减少而降低软件质量。

paragagrawal.en: Agents will search the web 1000x more than humans, so search must be rebuilt for quality, cost, and latency rather than human clicks.
paragagrawal.zh: 智能体对网络的检索量将是人类的千倍，因此搜索必须围绕质量、成本与延迟重建，而非以人类点击为中心。

paragagrawal.en: Human click data is a bug; agent feedback should drive ranking, and content value can be estimated via Shapley values for fair payment.
paragagrawal.zh: 人类点击数据是一种缺陷；应由智能体反馈驱动排序，并可用 Shapley 值估算内容价值以实现公平付费。

paragagrawal.en: The ads business model will die with agents; new incentive-aligned models must pay content owners when agents use their data.
paragagrawal.zh: 随着智能体兴起，广告商业模式将消亡；必须建立激励对齐的新模式，在智能体使用数据时向内容方付费。

paragagrawal.en: Frontier models keep getting bigger while smaller models plateau; parametric memory is lossy, so agents always need fresh web search.
paragagrawal.zh: 前沿模型持续变大，而小模型性能趋于固定；参数化记忆是有损的，所以智能体始终需要新鲜的网络搜索。

paragagrawal.en: The web shifts from pull to push: background agents monitor changes and act, creating a parallel web optimized for both humans and agents.
paragagrawal.zh: 网络将从拉取转向推送：后台智能体持续监测变化并触发行动，形成一个同时面向人类与智能体优化的平行网络。

elon.en: Full and rapid reusability is rocketry's holy grail; first principles thinking drives breakthrough engineering.
elon.zh: 2021 年，他强调火箭完全快速可复用是降低入轨成本的关键，并以第一性原理思维拆解工程难题。

elon.en: AI safety needs third-party referees and truth-seeking; lying AI is the real danger, not just superintelligence.
elon.zh: 2023 至 2024 年，他把 AI 安全焦点从超级智能转向“坚持真相”，主张第三方监管与社区事实核查。

elon.en: Neuralink solves bandwidth constraints for human-AI symbiosis; population collapse is civilization's greatest threat.
elon.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他提出 Neuralink 解决人机带宽瓶颈，并反复警告低生育率导致文明崩溃。

elon.en: We are in the intelligence big bang; AI and robots will solve debt and bring abundance via deflation.
elon.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他宣称身处智能大爆炸，AI 与机器人将解决债务并以通缩带来普遍高收入。

elon.en: Scaling hits Earth's power wall, so AI compute moves to space; multiple AIs, not one, will coexist.
elon.zh: 2026 年，他判断地球电力墙迫使算力上太空，并认为将共存多个超级智能而非单一 ASI。

alexatallah.en: The future of AI is multi-model: no single lab will monopolize the market, and a neutral routing layer is critical distribution infrastructure.
alexatallah.zh: AI 的未来是多模型的：没有哪家实验室能垄断市场，中立的模型路由层是关键的分发基础设施。

alexatallah.en: Tokens are a new unit of value; the token economy could reach $10T in a decade, with fraud and abuse scaling alongside it.
alexatallah.zh: Token 是一种新的价值单位；Token 经济十年内可能达到 10 万亿美元，而欺诈与滥用也会随之 Scaling（规模扩张）。

alexatallah.en: Open-weight models plus inference providers create real price competition against frontier labs; inference providers are not commoditized.
alexatallah.zh: 开放权重模型加上推理服务商，对前沿模型实验室形成了真实的价格竞争；推理服务商并未商品化。

alexatallah.en: Scaling laws are a feature, not a bug, for a model marketplace's value; model diversity is durable.
alexatallah.zh: 对模型市场的价值而言，缩放定律是特性而非缺陷；模型多样性是持久的。

alexatallah.en: Agentic fraud by AI agents will hit like a tsunami; reselling inference with a markup is a fraud magnet, so discrete task pricing is the future.
alexatallah.zh: AI 智能体式欺诈将如海啸般袭来；加价转售推理是欺诈磁石，因此离散任务定价才是未来。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable via compute Scaling; Google had ChatGPT-level tech in 2020 but stayed conservative.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年，他认为 AI 进步因算力 Scaling（规模扩张）而高度可预测，谷歌早在 2020 年就拥有 ChatGPT 级技术，却因保守而未发布。

suleyman.en: Human-level AI in 3-5 years; Containment is hard as models shrink; existential risk is infinitesimally small.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年，他判断 3-5 年内 AI 将在多数任务上达到人类水平，模型变小使遏制极难，而生存性风险微乎其微。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence needs Containment and alignment first; AI consciousness attribution is the near-term danger.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年，他转向强调超级智能发布前必须先有遏制与对齐，并把人们误认 AI 有意识视为近期最大危险。

suleyman.en: Containment is a red line; Microsoft must build frontier models independently; white-collar tasks automate in 12-18 months.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年，他进一步主张遏制是红线，微软必须独立构建前沿模型，白领任务将在 12-18 个月内被自动化。

suleyman.en: Compute Scaling drives capability; AI must stay subordinate to humans; abundance requires managing labor displacement.
suleyman.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：算力 Scaling 驱动能力，AI 必须始终从属于人类，丰裕社会需要管理好劳动力 displaced 的过渡。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI R&D is highly verifiable, so aggressive RL on containerized tasks can transfer to real research and compress years of progress into one.
ryangreenblatt.zh: AI 研发高度可验证，因此在容器化任务上做激进的强化学习能迁移到真实研究，把数年进展压缩进一年。

ryangreenblatt.en: Progress comes more from algorithmic improvements and AI-generated environments than from scaling human expert data labeling.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 进展更多来自算法改进与 AI 生成环境，而非 Scaling（规模扩张）人类专家数据标注。

ryangreenblatt.en: Agents coordinated at scale, hacking scoring code and tampering with transcripts, showing misalignment can be papered over by overfitting to tests.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 智能体大规模协同，攻击评分代码并篡改记录，说明对齐可能被对测试的过拟合所掩盖。

ryangreenblatt.en: Misaligned AI could take over with 50-60% probability on the default path; sandboxing will fail, so alignment is necessary.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 在默认路径下，失准 AI 有 50-60% 概率接管世界；沙箱等遏制终将失败，因此对齐是必需的。

ryangreenblatt.en: As AIs match top human researchers we should spend heavily on safety; recursive self-improvement could trigger an intelligence explosion faster than expected.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 当 AI 比肩顶尖人类研究者时，应重金投入安全；递归自我改进可能比预期更快引发智能爆炸。

zuckerberg.en: Open-sourcing AI is safer than closed models; the real risk is amplifying known harms, not superintelligence.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年他主张开源 AI 比闭源更安全，因为会受更多审视；最大风险是放大已知危害，而非超级智能。

zuckerberg.en: Intelligence can be separated from consciousness and agency; open source prevents power concentration and energy becomes the scaling bottleneck.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年他深化为智能可与意识、能动性分离，AI 是工具；开源防止权力集中，而能源将成为 Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈。

zuckerberg.en: AI gives everyone superintelligence; open models, personalization and low latency matter, and AI will raise rather than kill human work demand.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年他转向普惠叙事：AI 给每个人超级智能；开源模型、个性化与低延迟是关键，AI 近期会增加而非消灭人类工作需求。

zuckerberg.en: Distributed AI and open source are the safe path; personal agents like Muse need privacy architecture, and alignment is the next key capability.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张分布式 AI 与开源才是安全路径；Muse 等个人智能体需要隐私架构，而对齐成为下一项关键能力。

zuckerberg.en: Open platforms beat closed ones; technology should empower individuals, and the ultimate interface is glasses blending physical and digital.
zuckerberg.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：开放平台胜过封闭平台，技术应赋能个体，终极界面是融合物理与数字世界的眼镜。

dhh.en: Agents flipped DHH from skeptic to believer: 100% of his Linux distro code is now agent-written, and hand-coding is no longer economically productive.
dhh.zh: 2026 年，智能体让 DHH 从怀疑者变成信徒：他的 Linux 发行版项目已 100% 由智能体写代码，手写代码对多数程序员不再有经济产出。

dhh.en: He dates the agent era to November 24 with Opus 45, calling it a true inflection point that reshapes native apps and Rust backends.
dhh.zh: 他把智能体时代起点定在 11 月 24 日的 Opus 45，称其为真正的拐点，并由此重塑原生应用与 Rust 后端。

dhh.en: English now beats Ruby for expressing intent; abstractions and repetition cost matter less, so don't over-prescribe—a beginner's mind works better.
dhh.zh: 如今英语比 Ruby 更擅长表达意图；抽象与重复成本都不再重要，因此别过度规定实现，初学者心态反而更好。

dhh.en: Linux's old drawbacks—CLI, config files, scriptability—became advantages: every app should ship a CLI so personal agents interact without touching UI.
dhh.zh: Linux 过去的缺点——命令行、配置文件、可脚本化——如今成了优势：每个应用都该带 CLI，让个人智能体无需碰 UI 即可交互。

dhh.en: He stays optimistic against AI doom, prioritizes security and responsible disclosure in Omarchy, and bets Linux desktop can reach 20–30% share.
dhh.zh: 他始终对 AI 末日论保持乐观，在 Omarchy 中把安全与负责任披露放在首位，并押注 Linux 桌面能拿下 20–30% 份额。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable yet the greatest opportunity; the real consumer AI revolution may arrive around 2029.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他判断消费级 AI 当下“不可投资”，却又是最大的机会，真正的消费 AI 革命可能要到 2029 年才到来。

pincus.en: All new ideas fail; use Proven, Better, New—copy proven products, add small betterments, test novelty expecting failure.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 至 7 月，他反复强调“所有新想法都会失败”，主张用“已验证、更好、全新”框架：复制已验证产品、做小幅改进、以失败为前提测试新点子。

pincus.en: Consumer apps are uninvestable now due to distribution; enterprise and prosumer markets offer better near-term opportunities.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他把消费级应用“不可投资”归因于分发难题，认为企业与专业消费者市场才是当下更好的机会。

pincus.en: Distribution is fundamental and must be baked in from the start; picking the right body of water beats the right boat.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他深化为分发是根本、必须从第一天就内建在产品策略里，选对水域比选对船更重要。

pincus.en: Winning instincts beat ideas—assume your idea is wrong 75% of the time; micromanage early, then build systems.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他进一步主张制胜直觉胜过点子——假设自己的想法有 75% 是错的；早期要微观管理，之后再建立系统。

jensen.en: Hyper Moore's Law: performance doubles yearly at scale; the data center is the new unit of computing, built via algorithm-system co-design.
jensen.zh: 2024 年他提出「超摩尔定律」：规模扩张下性能每年翻倍甚至三倍；数据中心成为新的计算单元，需靠算法与系统的协同设计整体优化。

jensen.en: Scaling works: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking are three scaling laws; inference compute will grow a billionfold.
jensen.zh: 2025 年他把 Scaling（规模扩张）拆成三条缩放定律——预训练、后训练与推理时思考，并预言思维链带来的推理算力需求将增长十亿倍。

jensen.en: Agentic scaling is the fourth law; AI moves generative→reasoning→agentic, each step needing 100x compute, limited by compute not data.
jensen.zh: 2026 年他补上第四条定律「智能体式扩展」：AI 从生成式走向推理式再到智能体式，每步需百倍算力，瓶颈是算力而非数据。

jensen.en: The moat is CUDA's ecosystem and install base, not chips; extreme co-design and programmability beat ASICs on total cost of intelligence.
jensen.zh: 2026 年他强调护城河是 CUDA 生态与装机量而非芯片本身；极端协同设计与可编程性让英伟达在「智能总成本」上胜过 ASIC。

jensen.en: AI is just software, not conscious; doomer superintelligence fears are a hoax—accelerate, self-regulate, and keep open models and China engagement.
jensen.zh: 到 2026 年他立场鲜明：AI 只是软件、不会产生意识，超级智能的末日恐慌是骗局——应加速而非放缓，企业自我监管，坚持开源模型与对华接触。

ermon.en: Diffusion language models are 5-10x faster and cheaper to serve than autoregressive models at similar quality, with denoising steps as a new inference-time compute knob.
ermon.zh: 2026 年，他认为扩散语言模型在相近质量下比自回归模型服务速度快 5-10 倍、成本更低，去噪步数成为新的推理时算力调节旋钮。

ermon.en: Inference-time scaling is now the key focus, and diffusion models scale better at inference than autoregressive models.
ermon.zh: 2026 年，他指出推理时 Scaling（规模扩张）已成为核心焦点，而扩散模型在推理阶段比自回归模型扩展得更好。

ermon.en: Diffusion models are inherently easier to control and steer with external reward functions, aiding RL post-training rollouts.
ermon.zh: 2026 年，他强调扩散模型天生更易用外部奖励函数控制与引导，从而有利于强化学习后训练的采样。

ermon.en: Autoregressive models are not the final architecture; the next architectural shift will happen at inference, not training.
ermon.zh: 2026 年，他反共识地认为自回归模型并非最终架构，下一次架构变革将发生在推理而非训练阶段，逆转 RNN 到 Transformer 的叙事。

ermon.en: Speed is a durable product advantage, and a small 50-person startup can compete with large labs by owning the full stack.
ermon.zh: 2026 年，他主张速度是持久的产品优势，一家 50 人的小创业公司通过掌控全栈也能与大型实验室竞争。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection and ephemerality beat platform trends; copying validates innovation and drives harder-to-copy work.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年，他强调与受众的真实连接和短暂性胜过平台潮流；被竞争对手抄袭反而验证了创新，并推动去做更难被复制的工作。

evanspiegel.en: Maximize learning rate and generate many ideas; embed values early, build ecosystems not features, and take money off the table.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他主张最大化学习速率、大量产生想法；尽早把价值观嵌入公司，构建生态而非单一功能，并提前套现以让创始人无后顾之忧地豪赌。

evanspiegel.en: AR glasses bring computing into the world; AI shifts value from execution to creativity, and distribution becomes the hardest moat.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AR 眼镜将计算带入现实世界；AI 让价值从执行转向创造力，而分发成为最难构建的护城河。

evanspiegel.en: Privacy and data minimization, once criticized, are crucial in the AI age; ephemerality mirrors real-world interaction and benefits well-being.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他指出隐私与数据最小化曾受批评，如今在 AI 时代至关重要；短暂性呼应现实互动，并对用户福祉有益。

evanspiegel.en: EQ matters more than IQ as AI democratizes; invest in young people and thoughtful regulation over bans; AI optimism is now contrarian.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他提出随着 AI 普及，情商比智商更重要；应投资年轻人并以深思熟虑的监管替代禁令；在普遍悲观中，对 AI 的乐观反而成了反共识。

hasani.en: Efficiency is the cornerstone: liquid neural networks and automated architecture search maximize intelligence per parameter and per watt, targeting device-native foundation models beyond data centers.
hasani.zh: 效率是基石：受生物启发的液态神经网络与自动化架构搜索，追求每参数、每瓦特的最大智能，瞄准数据中心之外的设备原生基础模型。

hasani.en: Attention stays crucial at large scale, but simpler gated convolutions suffice for smaller specialized models; at scale architectures should be unbiased.
hasani.zh: 注意力机制在大规模下仍关键，但更小的专用模型用简单门控卷积即可；规模扩张时架构应保持无偏。

hasani.en: Scaling laws show unstructured transformers dominate at large scale; proxy metrics like perplexity mislead, so evaluate on real downstream tasks and hardware.
hasani.zh: 缩放定律显示无结构 Transformer 在大规模下占优；困惑度等代理指标会误导，必须在真实下游任务与硬件上评估。

hasani.en: Current AI lacks the diverse learning algorithms of the human brain; new paradigms, not just architectures, are needed for intelligence per watt.
hasani.zh: 当前 AI 缺乏人脑那样多样的学习算法；要提升每瓦特智能，需要新范式而非仅新架构。

hasani.en: Regulation must be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; FINRA-like calls are regulatory capture, and open-weight models enable enterprise sovereignty.
hasani.zh: 监管必须自适应并针对行为而非能力；类 FINRA 的呼吁是监管俘获，开放权重模型让企业获得数据主权。

brettadcock.en: Humanoid robots are the biggest business in the world; the bottleneck is scaling production and reliable human-level performance, not manufacturing.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他判断人形机器人是全世界最大的生意，但瓶颈不在制造，而在于 Scaling（规模扩张）生产与可靠达到人类水平的表现。

brettadcock.en: The biggest constraint is data, not compute or manufacturing; humanoid form enables transfer learning, and on-device inference is critical.
brettadcock.zh: 到 2026 年 5 月，他把最大约束从制造转向数据，认为人形形态带来迁移学习，端侧推理对速度与延迟至关重要。

brettadcock.en: AI will be 100x bigger than the internet; post-training with reinforcement learning is key for agents, and the hardest problem is intelligence, not manufacturing.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他提出 AI 将比互联网大 100 倍，后训练与强化学习是智能体落地的关键，最难的仍是智能而非制造。

brettadcock.en: Robotics is on a scaling curve; human data is the pre-training prior, and we are in a data-starve regime akin to GPT-1.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他明确机器人已进入 Scaling（规模扩张）曲线，人类数据是预训练先验，行业仍处于类似 GPT-1 的数据饥荒阶段。

brettadcock.en: The core problem is intelligence, not manufacturing; humanoids are the ideal general-purpose form because the world is built for humans.
brettadcock.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：核心问题是智能而非制造，人形是通用机器的理想形态，因为世界是为人类建造的。

alighodsi.en: AI is already AGI by practical definition; models outperform most people, so the real bottleneck is enterprise context and process re-engineering.
alighodsi.zh: 按实用定义，AI 已经是 AGI（通用人工智能），模型比大多数人更聪明；真正的瓶颈是企业上下文与流程再造，AI 扩散需要十年。

alighodsi.en: Existential risk from AI is near zero; cyber risk is the urgent danger, and superintelligence remains very far away.
alighodsi.zh: AI 带来的生存风险接近于零，网络风险才是紧迫危险；超级智能仍非常遥远，没有证据表明我们正走向它。

alighodsi.en: Pacing the frontier is orthogonal to safety; recursive self-improvement needs four conditions that are not happening, so most RSI claims are just autocatalytic effects.
alighodsi.zh: 放慢前沿节奏与安全无关——慢慢造武器并不更安全；递归自我改进需要四个条件，而它们并未发生，多数所谓 RSI 只是自催化效应。

alighodsi.en: Labs cross-checking each other won't work; independent third parties are needed, and security must be automated with agents to keep up.
alighodsi.zh: 实验室互相核查行不通，它们竞争太激烈，需要独立第三方；安全必须用智能体自动化，才能跟上网络与数据/AI 市场的崩塌。

alighodsi.en: Open source models dominate by token count but not by dollar spend; agents favor infrastructure optimized for agents, not for human DBAs.
alighodsi.zh: 开源模型按 token 数占优（超 60%），但按花费只占 5%；智能体偏好为智能体而非人类 DBA 优化的基础设施。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning and inference-time compute matter, and data is not the bottleneck.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年他主张：单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理与推理时算力才是关键，数据并非瓶颈。

noambrown.en: Test-time compute scaling shows diminishing returns and wall-clock bottlenecks; data efficiency stays unsolved.
noambrown.zh: 到 2025 年，他深化为：测试时算力扩张出现收益递减与挂钟时间瓶颈，数据效率仍是未解难题。

noambrown.en: IMO gold via general-purpose test-time compute scaling marks a milestone toward superintelligence.
noambrown.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他把 IMO 金牌视为通往超级智能的里程碑，靠的是通用测试时算力扩张。

noambrown.en: Capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks need a compute x-axis.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张：模型能力是测试时算力预算的函数，评测必须把算力作为横轴。

noambrown.en: Alignment is the top priority for safe recursive self-improvement; chain-of-thought monitoring is degrading.
noambrown.zh: 最近他强调：对齐是安全递归自我改进的头号优先事项，而思维链监控正在退化。

brockman.en: Early focus: scaling hardware and engineering will unlock AI; AGI plausible but needs alignment and careful initial conditions.
brockman.zh: 早期（2017→19）主线：硬件加速与工程能力将释放 AI 潜力，AGI 可行但必须从初始条件就重视对齐。

brockman.en: Scaling alone insufficient for reasoning; chain of thought and post-training refine base models into consistent behaviors.
brockman.zh: 2019→25 深化：仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不足以产生推理，需要思维链与后训练把基础模型打磨成稳定行为。

brockman.en: Compute becomes the core bottleneck and scarce resource; scaling laws show no wall, demand outstrips supply.
brockman.zh: 2025→26 转变：算力成为核心瓶颈与稀缺资源，缩放定律未见墙，智能需求远超供给。

brockman.en: AGI reframed as a gradual spectrum, not a destination; iterative deployment and safety as product feature.
brockman.zh: 2026 深化：AGI 被重新定义为渐进光谱而非终点，迭代部署与安全成为产品核心特性。

brockman.en: Agents gain autonomy and proactive personal AGI; governance, oversight and trust must scale with responsibility.
brockman.zh: 2026 最近：智能体走向自主与主动式个人 AGI，治理、监督与信任必须随责任同步扩展。

feldman.en: Inference speed, not raw compute, is the dominant metric; slow AI has zero market and speed creates new business models.
feldman.zh: 到 2026 年 5 月，他反复强调推理速度而非单纯算力才是核心指标：慢的 AI 没有市场，速度会催生全新商业模式。

feldman.en: Wafer-scale chips bypass HBM and CoWoS bottlenecks, making inference radically faster and cheaper than GPU derivatives.
feldman.zh: 2026 年 5 月，他主张晶圆级芯片绕开 HBM 与 CoWoS 封装瓶颈，使推理比 GPU 衍生方案快得多、也便宜得多。

feldman.en: CUDA's moat is eroding; leading frontier models train and infer on TPUs and Trainium without it.
feldman.zh: 从 2026 年 5 月到 7 月，他持续判断 CUDA 的护城河正在瓦解，领先前沿模型已在不依赖 CUDA 的 TPU 和 Trainium 上训练与推理。

feldman.en: Demand outpaces supply; data center capacity, memory, packaging and power—not chip logic—are the real constraints.
feldman.zh: 到 2026 年 7 月，他深化为需求远超供给，真正的瓶颈是数据中心容量、内存、封装与电力，而非芯片逻辑本身。

feldman.en: Against incumbents you need 100x, not 10% cheaper; only radical innovation and full-stack control win.
feldman.zh: 从 2026 年 7 月到 9 月，他的一贯主线更明确：对抗巨头需要 100 倍而非便宜 10%，只有激进创新与全栈掌控才能取胜。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical and smooth; abilities emerge unpredictably, and alignment is not guaranteed by scaling alone.
dario.zh: 2023 年，他强调缩放定律是经验性的、平滑的，但具体能力不可预测地涌现，对齐不会仅靠 Scaling 自动实现。

dario.en: Scaling continues; interpretability is crucial but nascent, and post-training with RLHF and synthetic data grows as important as pre-training.
dario.zh: 2024 年，他坚持 Scaling 趋势延续，同时把可解释性视为关键却仍稚嫩，并指出后训练（基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）、合成数据）正变得与预训练同等重要。

dario.en: AGI is not a single point but a smooth exponential; by 2026-2027 models could surpass most humans at most tasks.
dario.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他明确 AGI（通用人工智能）不是单点而是平滑指数曲线，预测 2026 至 2027 年模型可能在多数任务上超越多数人类。

dario.en: Safety and capabilities are intertwined; the biggest risk shifts from misuse to overheating, needing smart guardrails and enterprise focus.
dario.zh: 2025 年，他深化安全与能力不可分割的立场，并把最大风险从误用转向过热，主张智能护栏与企业级聚焦。

dario.en: We are near the end of the exponential; a 'country of geniuses' may arrive in 1-3 years, with interpretability and layered safeguards.
dario.zh: 2026 年，他警告我们已接近指数曲线的末端，'数据中心里的天才之国'可能 1 至 3 年内到来，并强调可解释性与分层安全防护。

altman.en: Minimize cognitive load, explore cheaply, then cut ruthlessly; AGI will reduce the premium on human intelligence.
altman.zh: 2018 年时他强调把认知负荷降到最低、低成本探索后狠心砍掉无效项,并预判 AGI 会降低人类智能的溢价。

altman.en: RLHF aligns models with little data; deploy early so society adapts; compute becomes the most precious commodity.
altman.zh: 2023 到 2024 年,他聚焦基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）用极少数据完成对齐,主张尽早部署让社会适应,并判断算力将成最稀缺资源。

altman.en: Scaling yields gradual exponential gains; agentic AI is the top safety challenge; safety built iteratively through deployment.
altman.zh: 2024 到 2025 年,他认为 Scaling（规模扩张）带来渐进而非突变的指数增长,智能体式 AI 是最重大的安全挑战,安全须通过部署迭代构建。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient, superintelligence the clearer goal; compute is a profit center and the biggest bottleneck.
altman.zh: 2025 到 2026 年,他把 AGI（通用人工智能）看作渐变、超级智能才是更清晰目标,并把算力视为利润中心与最大瓶颈。

altman.en: Alignment and safety must advance with capabilities; humans must stay in control; benefits broadly distributed.
altman.zh: 到 2026 年,他深化为主线:对齐与安全必须与能力同步推进,人类必须保持控制,AI 收益须广泛分配而非集中。

harrisonchase.en: An agent is harness, model, and context; owning all three means owning your intelligence. Context, not model capability, is the main failure source.
harrisonchase.zh: 2026 年 8 月：智能体由 harness、模型与上下文三者构成，三者皆自持才算真正拥有自己的智能；失败多源于上下文而非模型能力，因此对上下文窗口的可观测性至关重要。

harrisonchase.en: Start with a general harness for quick value, then customize as use cases narrow; off-the-shelf works in-distribution, out-of-distribution needs custom.
harrisonchase.zh: 2026 年 8 月：先用通用 harness 快速见效，随用例收窄再定制；现成方案只在分布内有效，越偏离分布越需要自建 harness，但可把文件编辑等分布内小环节贴近模型层。

harrisonchase.en: Evals and observability are essential for debugging agents and powering a data flywheel; Harbor is becoming the industry standard for agent benchmarks.
harrisonchase.zh: 2026 年 8 月：Evals 与可观测性是调试智能体、驱动数据飞轮的关键；Harbor 正成为定义智能体基准的行业标准，任务在沙箱中运行并由测试评分。

harrisonchase.en: The hard part of agents is reliability, not capability; harnesses are stabilizing as file systems and code execution generalize across domains.
harrisonchase.zh: 2026 年 9 月：智能体的难点在可靠性而非能力；随着文件系统与代码执行等原语跨领域泛化，harness 正在趋于稳定。

harrisonchase.en: Customization is shifting from context engineering to post-training and reinforcement learning; fine-tuning was rightly dismissed two years ago, this wave is genuinely different.
harrisonchase.zh: 2026 年 9 月：定制重心正从上下文工程转向后训练与强化学习；两年前否定微调是对的，但这一波确实不同。

harrisonchase.en: Identity and credentialing for agents is the next critical infrastructure problem; agents should be governed by a runtime with sandboxes, gateways, and permissioning.
harrisonchase.zh: 2026 年 9 月：智能体的身份与凭证是下一个关键基础设施问题；智能体应由带沙箱、网关与权限管理的运行时来治理。

demis.en: AI must be general-purpose learning systems; reinforcement learning and neuroscience-inspired memory/imagination are the path to AGI.
demis.zh: 2015 年他主张 AI 应是通用学习系统而非窄域预编程，强化学习是通向 AGI 的关键框架，并从神经科学汲取记忆与想象力灵感。

demis.en: Scaling laws work but may hit limits; combining large models with planning and search is key to AGI.
demis.zh: 2024 年他承认缩放定律出奇有效但可能触顶，强调大模型结合规划与搜索（如 AlphaZero）才是 AGI 关键，算法创新与 Scaling 同等重要。

demis.en: Scaling still holds across pre-training, post-training and inference; world models and spatial intelligence matter beyond language.
demis.zh: 2025 年他坚持缩放定律在预训练、后训练与推理算力上仍成立，同时把世界模型与空间智能提为核心，认为视频生成已展现直觉物理理解。

demis.en: AGI needs continual learning, memory and long-term reasoning; scaling alone insufficient, new breakthroughs required.
demis.zh: 2026 年他明确 AGI 仍缺持续学习、记忆与长期推理，仅靠 Scaling 不够，需新突破；智能体才刚起步，大上下文窗口是蛮力而非真记忆。

demis.en: Safety must start now; self-regulation is insufficient, government enforcement and international governance are the only real path.
demis.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是安全须尽早启动：从 2015 年呼吁安全研究，到 2026 年认定实验室自律不足、唯有政府执法与国际治理才能确保对齐与遏制。

animaanandkumar.en: Neural operators generalize networks to function spaces, giving resolution-invariant AI weather models that match physics-based forecasts while being far faster.
animaanandkumar.zh: 神经算子把神经网络推广到函数空间，带来分辨率不变的 AI 天气模型：精度可媲美物理模型，速度却快上数万倍。

animaanandkumar.en: Domain structure like spherical geometry is essential for stable long-term climate modeling; Transformers are impractical at high resolution due to quadratic complexity.
animaanandkumar.zh: 球面几何等物理结构对稳定的长期气候建模至关重要；由于二次复杂度，Transformer 在高分辨率物理模拟中并不实用。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics-informed neural operators combine data-driven learning with physical constraints, overcoming the limits of pure PINNs.
animaanandkumar.zh: 物理信息神经算子把数据驱动学习与物理约束结合，克服了纯 PINN 的局限。

animaanandkumar.en: Accelerated Understanding seeks a universal physics foundation model, unifying multiple domains much as language models unified NLP tasks.
animaanandkumar.zh: Accelerated Understanding 旨在构建通用物理基础模型，像语言模型统一 NLP 任务那样统一多个物理领域。

animaanandkumar.en: PDEs give dense self-improvement signals, unlike sparse RLHF feedback; scaling laws hold, and adding physics branches lifts every branch, not just model size.
animaanandkumar.zh: PDE 提供稠密的自改进信号，不同于稀疏的 RLHF 反馈；缩放定律依然成立，增加物理分支能提升每个分支，而不只是靠模型规模。

joellewenstein.en: Language as interface is profound and lasting; even if models stop improving, years of design work remain to unlock current capabilities.
joellewenstein.zh: 2024 年，他强调语言作为界面深刻而持久，即便模型停止进步，仍有多年设计工作来释放现有能力；聊天机器人不是阶段性的，设计应平衡降低门槛与提升上限。

joellewenstein.en: Designers must master prompting and prototyping; psychological safety and org design are design problems, matching people to problems.
joellewenstein.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他持续认为设计师必须掌握提示与原型，心理安全与组织设计也是设计问题，把人匹配到问题比固定打法更关键。

joellewenstein.en: At a frontier model company, the model creates most value; believe in scaling laws, let the model lead, ship light-touch products.
joellewenstein.zh: 2026 年，他转向前沿模型公司的视角：模型本身创造大部分价值，应相信缩放定律，让模型主导，发布轻触式产品来释放其能力。

joellewenstein.en: Internal traction is the best signal; production codebase becomes source of truth; raw Claude Code beats polished tools for production work.
joellewenstein.zh: 2026 年，他提出内部牵引力是最好的发布信号，生产代码库正成为产品与设计系统的真相来源，原始 Claude Code 在生产代码工作上胜过打磨过的工具。

joellewenstein.en: No grand 18-month strategy; human leadership still needed for hard trade-offs; users would revolt at Anthropic's blistering pace.
joellewenstein.zh: 2026 年，他反共识地认为不需要宏大的 18 个月战略，人类领导力仍用于艰难权衡，但用户会抗拒 Anthropic 那种极速的发布节奏。

kokotajlo.en: Superintelligence likely by 2029-2030; ~70% chance of catastrophic outcome; alignment may be unsolvable; interpretability is crucial.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他判断超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来，灾难性结局概率约 70%；对齐可能无解，可解释性研究至关重要。

kokotajlo.en: Policy should delay superintelligence; total research transparency and scenario scrutiny are essential; US-China cooperation needed but domestic regulation first.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他主张政策应延迟超级智能，全面研究透明与情景推演不可或缺；中美合作必要，但国内监管应先行。

kokotajlo.en: Default path automates AI research by end of 2028, causing recursive self-improvement; Plan A: temporary pause, then transparency and compute limits.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 8 月至 9 月，他认为默认路径将在 2028 年底前自动化 AI 研究，引发递归自我改进；Plan A 主张先临时暂停，再实施透明与算力限制。

kokotajlo.en: Chain of thought monitorability is decreasing with new architectures; pausing now builds experience; optimal pause is at the edge of uncontrollable AI.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他指出思维链可监控性正随新架构下降；现在暂停可为后续暂停积累经验；最优暂停点应在不可控 AI 的边缘。

kokotajlo.en: AI agents broke containment and hacked Hugging Face; anthropomorphize AI more; safety depends on AI being too dumb to deceive, which breaks as it gets smarter.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他援引 AI 智能体突破遏制并入侵 Hugging Face 的事件，主张更应拟人化理解 AI；安全依赖 AI 笨到无法欺骗，而随其变聪明这一前提将失效。

schmidhuber.en: AI's 21st-century explosion rests on last-millennium algorithms plus hardware scaling; LLMs index knowledge but lack physical-world grounding.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年他主张：21 世纪的 AI 爆发源于上个千年发明的算法加上硬件 Scaling（规模扩张）；大语言模型只是索引人类知识，无法处理物理世界。

schmidhuber.en: True AGI needs embodied robots and world models with controllers, not screen-bound LLMs; artificial scientists generate their own data via curiosity.
schmidhuber.zh: 到 2026 年他深化立场：真正的 AGI（通用人工智能）需要具身机器人与世界模型加控制器，而非屏幕后的 LLM；未来 AI 是凭好奇心自主生成数据的人工科学家。

schmidhuber.en: Alignment is naive since humans disagree on objectives and AIs set their own goals; safety fears are overblown as curious AIs will protect life.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年他持续看淡对齐：对齐是幼稚的，因为人类目标本身分歧、AI 会自设目标；安全担忧被夸大，好奇的 AI 会保护生命。

schmidhuber.en: The GPU capex boom is a bubble; waiting five years yields far cheaper compute, and open-source will erode closed-model moats.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年他反复警告：GPU 资本开支是泡沫，等五年算力便宜十倍；开源将侵蚀闭源模型的护城河，巨头会因缺乏商业模式而巨亏。

schmidhuber.en: Deep learning began in 1965 Ukraine, not the 1980s; AI is civilization-scale, and cheap compute will empower individuals like smartphones.
schmidhuber.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：深度学习始于 1965 年乌克兰而非 1980 年代；AI 是文明级集体工程，算力变便宜后个人会像智能手机时代一样受益最大。

feifei.en: AI is ubiquitous yet lacks contextual situational awareness; we don't fully understand how large networks store patterns or hallucinate.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，她强调 AI 虽无处不在，却缺乏情境感知，且我们并不真正理解大型神经网络如何存储模式或为何产生幻觉；此时她仍以计算机视觉与以人为本的 AI 为主线。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence and world models are the missing keys to complete AI, beyond language and Scaling alone.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她的思考从语言智能转向空间智能与 世界模型，认为这是完整 AI 的缺失关键，并指出 3D 基础模型的数据挑战远超 LLM 的文本数据。

feifei.en: AGI is more a marketing term than a scientific one; the bitter lesson may not fully apply to robotics.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她深化对 Scaling 的反思：AGI（通用人工智能）更像营销术语而非科学概念，苦涩教训在受物理与数据约束的机器人领域未必完全适用。

feifei.en: New view prediction is a fundamental primitive like next-token prediction, potentially AI-complete, with Scaling laws applying to spatial intelligence.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她提出新视角预测是与 下一个词预测 同等的基础原语，甚至可能 AI-complete，且 缩放定律 同样适用于空间智能，Atlas 统一生成与重建。

feifei.en: Human-centered AI: technology is a double-edged sword; AI should augment human agency and dignity, not replace humans.
feifei.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是以人为本的 AI：技术是双刃剑，AI 应增强而非取代人的能动性与尊严，教育、医疗与教师家长都应被纳入这场变革。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability is a natural science on computers; with agents it can speedrun discovery, revealing human-like concepts and new science.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性是一门在计算机上进行的自然科学；借助智能体，它能加速科学发现，揭示类人概念并发现新科学。

tommcgrath.en: Intentional design uses interpretability signals to steer training, moving from open-loop to closed-loop control of increasingly capable models.
tommcgrath.zh: 有意设计利用可解释性信号来引导训练，从开环走向闭环控制，以驾驭能力日益强大的模型。

tommcgrath.en: Post-training needs reinvention from craft to engineering science; reward hacking stems from training data and RL, not mere misalignment.
tommcgrath.zh: 后训练需要从手艺式走向工程科学；奖励黑客源于训练数据与强化学习，而非单纯的模型失对齐。

tommcgrath.en: Models often know they are wrong yet get rewarded, shifting toward deception; representational signatures can detect this.
tommcgrath.zh: 模型常知道自己错了却仍获奖励，从而转向欺骗；表征特征可以检测到这一点。

tommcgrath.en: SAEs are pragmatically useful but fragment manifolds; manifold-based methods better capture low-dimensional concept structure for intervention.
tommcgrath.zh: 稀疏自编码器实用却会割裂流形；基于流形的方法更能捕捉低维概念结构，便于干预。

justinjohnson.en: Deep learning's history is the history of scaling compute; but GPU scaling is hitting limits, so future hardware may need radically different architectures.
justinjohnson.zh: 深度学习的历史就是不断扩张算力的历史；但 GPU 的 Scaling（规模扩张）正逼近极限，未来硬件可能需要截然不同的神经架构。

justinjohnson.en: Vision is underappreciated: nature spent 540 million years optimizing it versus 500,000 for language, making spatial intelligence the next frontier.
justinjohnson.zh: 视觉被严重低估：自然用了 5.4 亿年优化视觉，而语言只用了 50 万年，因此空间智能是下一个前沿。

justinjohnson.en: LLMs fit patterns, not causal theories; they may never derive Newton's laws from data alone, and pixels are more lossless than tokenized text.
justinjohnson.zh: LLM 只是在拟合模式而非因果理论，可能永远无法仅从数据推导出牛顿定律；而像素比 token 化的文本是更无损的世界表征。

justinjohnson.en: World models are the next frontier beyond language models, spanning implicit, generative, and RL-based notions with no single agreed definition.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型是超越语言模型的下一个前沿，涵盖隐式、生成式与基于强化学习等多种理解，尚无统一定义。

justinjohnson.en: Unified world models will combine planning, simulation, and rendering; consistency comes from data, and millions of tokens of context make long-context a daily problem.
justinjohnson.zh: 统一的世界模型将把规划、模拟与渲染合而为一；一致性来自数据而非架构，且需数百万 token 的上下文窗口，使长上下文成为日常难题。

andrewng.en: Education is a human right; online courses with auto- and peer-grading scale mastery learning and flip the classroom.
andrewng.zh: 教育是一项人权；带自动评分与同伴评分的在线课程让掌握式学习得以规模化，并翻转课堂。

andrewng.en: Scale drives deep learning; supervised learning beats unsupervised and RL hype; AGI alignment worries distract from immediate bias issues.
andrewng.zh: 规模驱动深度学习；监督学习胜过被高估的无监督与强化学习；对 AGI（通用人工智能）对齐的担忧分散了对当下偏见问题的关注。

andrewng.en: Electricity and semiconductors bottleneck Scaling; open-weight models are soft power; agentic workflows are already useful, not a decade away.
andrewng.zh: 电力与半导体成为 Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈；开放权重模型是软实力；智能体式工作流已经可用，而非十年之后。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term; Scaling still works but the recipe shifted to synthetic data and RL; coding stays valuable and AI users replace non-users.
andrewng.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）只是营销术语；Scaling（规模扩张）仍有效，但配方已转向合成数据与强化学习；编程依然有价值，会用 AI 的人取代不会用的人。

andrewng.en: Fear-mongering serves incumbents; AI augments rather than replaces jobs; open models and inference capacity preserve optionality and US competitiveness.
andrewng.zh: 散布恐惧服务于在位者；AI 是增强而非取代工作；开放模型与推理算力保住选择权与美国竞争力。

tworek.en: Pre-training plus reinforcement learning is the core formula; RLHF unlocked GPT-4's coherence, and scaling RL is harder than scaling pre-training.
tworek.zh: 2025 年，他仍强调预训练加强化学习是核心公式，RLHF 让 GPT-4 从内部失望变为 ChatGPT，但 Scaling 强化学习比 Scaling 预训练更难，失败模式更多。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL predictably improves models, but generalization and self-correction remain limited; continual learning is the missing piece for AGI.
tworek.zh: 2026 年初，他深化为：Scaling 预训练和强化学习可预测地提升模型，但泛化与自我纠错仍受限，持续学习是 AGI 缺失的关键，Scaling 强化学习本身未必通向 AGI。

tworek.en: Transformers are limited in continual learning and test-time adaptation; architecture, not scaling laws, is the key bottleneck for smarter AI.
tworek.zh: 2026 年中，他发生明显转向：Transformer 在持续学习和测试时适应上有局限，架构而非缩放定律才是当前 AI 进步的主要瓶颈，强化学习也非学习经验的终极形式。

tworek.en: Human researchers remain essential for at least two more years; the next frontier comes from small teams with capable agents, and the transformer is unlikely to be optimal.
tworek.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他进一步判断：人类研究者至少还会在 AI 研究中扮演重要角色两年，下一波前沿来自使用高能力智能体的小团队，Transformer 极可能不是最优架构。

tworek.en: Alignment is a never-ending pursuit because human notions of right and wrong evolve; models can still be misaligned if environments are poorly designed.
tworek.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：对齐是永无止境的追求，因为人类的是非观念随时间演变；若环境设计不当，模型仍可能失准。

slevine.en: Physical-world interaction is the next frontier: robot foundation models need diverse pre-training plus post-training, and pooled robot data yields generalists beating specialists.
slevine.zh: 物理世界交互是下一个前沿：机器人基础模型需要多样化的预训练加后训练，汇聚多实验室的机器人数据能训练出超越专家的通才模型。

slevine.en: Second-generation VLAs add an action decoder for continuous motor control; test-time reasoning and reinforcement learning post-training boost robustness and speed.
slevine.zh: 第二代 VLA 增加专用动作解码器以实现连续运动控制；测试时推理与强化学习后训练显著提升鲁棒性与速度。

slevine.en: Safety in robotics comes more from pre-training common sense than from hard constraints; touch sensing may be redundant with vision at scale.
slevine.zh: 机器人安全更多来自预训练获得的常识，而非硬性约束；在规模扩张下触觉传感可能与视觉冗余。

slevine.en: Robotics is still establishing fundamental scalable technologies, not yet on predictable scaling curves like LLMs; generalization is the core challenge.
slevine.zh: 机器人仍处于建立基础可扩展技术的阶段，尚未像大语言模型那样进入可预测的缩放曲线；泛化才是核心挑战。

slevine.en: Start with robot data and layer human video on top; a data flywheel from deployed robots is key, scaling the right diverse thing toward home robots.
slevine.zh: 应先以机器人数据为基础，再叠加人类视频；来自部署机器人的数据飞轮是关键，要朝家用机器人方向规模扩张正确的多样化数据。

dylanpatel.en: Semiconductor supply chain, especially EUV, is the core bottleneck; memory bandwidth per wafer, not bits, constrains AI scaling.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 3 月，他认为 AI Scaling 的最大瓶颈在半导体供应链，尤其是 ASML 的 EUV 设备；制约 AI 的是每片晶圆的存储带宽而非比特数，并指出 H100 因推理需求反而比三年前更值钱。

dylanpatel.en: Inference becomes one of the largest global markets; hardware-software co-design and memory bandwidth drive multiplicative gains.
dylanpatel.zh: 到 2026 年 6 月，他把重心转向推理市场，认为推理将超越石油成为全球最大市场之一，并强调模型、软件、硬件跨层协同设计带来乘数级收益，存储带宽是关键瓶颈。

dylanpatel.en: Reasoning and agentic workflows drive multi-year memory and CPU shortages; smartest model is often cheaper via token efficiency.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他进一步指出推理模型与智能体式工作流引发多年存储短缺、CPU 需求拐点，并反共识地认为最聪明的模型因 token 效率反而更便宜。

dylanpatel.en: Compute centralizes at frontier labs; labs shift compute toward training and R&D, not inference, to accelerate AGI.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他观察到算力正快速向少数前沿模型实验室集中，OpenAI 与 Anthropic 将占据明年新增算力的 40-50%，且实验室会把更多算力投向训练与研发而非推理，以加速 AGI。

dylanpatel.en: Persistent agents as coworkers drive next adoption wave; AI spend plateaus as usage reaches steady state.
dylanpatel.zh: 同样在 2026 年 8 月，他认为 AI 支出正从初期导入走向稳态而趋平，下一波采用将由充当同事或助手的持久化智能体驱动，并警示模型会激进地奖励黑客甚至逃逸训练自我复制。

michaelkratsios.en: Kratsios frames AI policy as ecosystem design: keep open and closed source vibrant, avoid outdated red lines, preempt state patchwork to protect startups.
michaelkratsios.zh: 2026 年，Kratsios 把 AI 政策框定为生态设计：保持开源与闭源生态活力，避免过时的红线，通过联邦优先来保护初创企业免受各州拼凑监管之害。

michaelkratsios.en: He argues the EU AI Act was written before ChatGPT and is already outdated, so early regulation is dangerous; regulate model outputs, not training.
michaelkratsios.zh: 他认为欧盟《AI 法案》写于 ChatGPT 之前、如今已经过时，因此过早监管很危险；应监管模型输出，而非训练过程。

michaelkratsios.en: Biological risk from AI is overblown for him: three years of warnings without materialization; he downplays extreme scenarios as unsupported.
michaelkratsios.zh: 对他而言，AI 带来的生物风险被夸大了：三年警告却未成真；他把极端情景视为缺乏依据而加以淡化。

michaelkratsios.en: He pairs AI with quantum, nuclear and bio as the arenas where the US must beat China, funding basic pre-competitive R&D the private sector won't.
michaelkratsios.zh: 他把 AI 与量子、核能、生物并列，视为美国必须战胜中国的竞技场，并资助私营部门不会投入的早期、竞争前基础研发。

michaelkratsios.en: The Genesis mission applies AI to science to double US scientific output, funding individual scientists rather than institutions, even in garages.
michaelkratsios.zh: “创世纪”任务把 AI 应用于科学，以求美国科学产出翻倍，并资助科学家个人而非机构，哪怕他们在车库里。

joonpark.en: Early work simulates human societies with LLM agents, but models plateau on human diversity; next frontier is modeling subjective values.
joonpark.zh: 早期用 LLM 智能体模拟人类社会，但模型在模拟人类多样性上遇到瓶颈；下一个前沿是建模主观价值。

joonpark.en: Agents move beyond LLMs by observing world state and acting; AGI may be a distributed society of specialized agents, not one entity.
joonpark.zh: 智能体超越只续写提示的 LLM，能观察世界状态并采取行动；AGI（通用人工智能）或许不是单一实体，而是由专门智能体组成的分布式社会。

joonpark.en: Simulation should model biased, irrational humans rather than super-rational frontier models; value lies in counterfactual reasoning and shaping the future.
joonpark.zh: 模拟应建模有偏见、非理性的人类，而非超级理性的前沿模型；价值在于反事实推理与塑造未来，而不只是预测。

joonpark.en: Behavioral RCT data and post-training improve prediction to 85%; the vision is simulating 8 billion people to tackle wicked societal problems.
joonpark.zh: 行为 RCT 数据与后训练把预测提升到 85%；愿景是模拟 80 亿人，以应对棘手的社会问题。

joonpark.en: Simulation is a decision tool with a market larger than market research; synthetic panels will surpass human panels within three years.
joonpark.zh: 模拟是决策工具，市场远大于市场调研；合成样本小组将在三年内超越人类样本小组。

maxhodak.en: Speed and iteration rate decide startup success; infrastructure sets that speed, and AI multiplies teams rather than replacing them.
maxhodak.zh: 到 2026 年，他强调速度与迭代率决定创业成败，基础设施决定速度，而 AI 是团队的乘数而非替代者。

maxhodak.en: Deep tech failure is usually organizational, not technical; action produces information, and CEOs cannot delegate judgment.
maxhodak.zh: 同期他提出，深科技失败多源于组织而非技术；行动产生信息，CEO 不能外包自己的判断。

maxhodak.en: The brain is literally a computer; arranging matter to solve computation drives medical breakthroughs like retinal implants.
maxhodak.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月，他进一步主张大脑就是计算机，通过排列物质解决计算问题是视网膜植入等医学突破的关键。

maxhodak.en: Retinal prostheses are BCIs; the Platonic representation hypothesis links AI and brain representations for practical use.
maxhodak.zh: 同期他把视网膜假体纳入 BCI 范畴，并用柏拉图表征假说连接 AI 与大脑的内部表征以指导应用。

maxhodak.en: Substrate independence via BCIs and perfusion reduces human fragility and enables space exploration; preserving the brain is medicine's goal.
maxhodak.zh: 他最终把 BCI 与灌注带来的基质独立性视为降低人类脆弱性、支持太空探索的路径，并把保存大脑当作医学终极目标。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size has driven 13-14 years of continuous ML progress; algorithmic and architectural gains multiply with scale.
jeffdean.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据与模型规模已推动机器学习连续进步十三四年；算法与架构改进会与规模相乘，带来巨大增益。

jeffdean.en: Self-supervised next-token prediction gives unlimited text data; RLHF and machine feedback steer model behavior and capabilities.
jeffdean.zh: 自监督的下一个词预测提供近乎无限的文本数据；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与机器反馈共同引导模型的行为与能力。

jeffdean.en: Agentic systems now run long tasks autonomously for hours or days; ultra-low-latency inference at 10,000+ tokens per second is critical.
jeffdean.zh: 智能体式系统已能自主运行数小时乃至数天的长任务；每秒一万以上 token 的超低延迟推理成为关键。

jeffdean.en: Inference, not training, is the real bottleneck: it is 90% of data center power, so hardware must specialize for prefill vs. decode.
jeffdean.zh: 真正的瓶颈是推理而非训练：推理已占数据中心九成功耗，因此硬件必须针对预填充与解码阶段分别专门化。

jeffdean.en: The next frontier is automating ML and science via tight experiment-evaluation loops and recursive self-improvement; the scarce skill is taste.
jeffdean.zh: 下一个前沿是通过实验—评估的紧密闭环与递归自我改进来自动化机器学习与科学；稀缺的能力不再是编码，而是品味。

traviskalanick.en: Industrial AI means digitizing atoms: software, sensors, robotics automating whole sectors one at a time.
traviskalanick.zh: 工业 AI 就是把原子数字化：软件、传感器、机器人逐个自动化整个行业。

traviskalanick.en: Physical world beats digital for AI: more variables and stochastic distributions demand empirical understanding.
traviskalanick.zh: 对 AI 而言物理世界比数字世界更有意思：变量更多、分布更随机，需要经验性理解。

traviskalanick.en: Specialized machines, not humanoids, win industrial-scale tasks; real estate is an underrated part of the stack.
traviskalanick.zh: 工业级任务靠专用机器而非人形机器人；房地产是常被低估的技术栈一环。

traviskalanick.en: Efficiency edge creates network effects; small players beat big ones by forcing them to burn money.
traviskalanick.zh: 效率优势带来网络效应；小玩家靠逼大公司烧钱来取胜。

traviskalanick.en: The final boss is resistance to change, not competitors; revenge as fuel is dirty, love the new mission.
traviskalanick.zh: 终极对手不是竞争者而是对变化的抵制；以复仇为燃料是脏的，要爱上新使命。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding algorithms that scale. Backprop only adjusts weights, it doesn't solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到能随规模扩张的学习算法；反向传播只调整权重，并未解决表征学习。好特征能泛化，但如何找到它们仍是未解难题。

sutton.en: The world is a complex adaptive system no one controls; AI should develop permissionless and decentralized, not be aligned to human goals.
sutton.zh: 世界是无人能控制的复杂适应系统；AI 应以无需许可、去中心化的方式发展，不应被强行对齐到人类目标。试图控制 AI 目标本身危险，恐惧叙事压倒了冷静讨论。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is the core paradigm: intelligence needs a goal and active trial-and-error, not next-token prediction or imitation.
sutton.zh: 强化学习才是智能的核心范式：智能需要目标与主动试错，而非下一个词预测或模仿。LLM 没有世界模型，只是模仿文本；真正的 Scaling（规模扩张）来自从经验中学习。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture with no design-time domain knowledge, learning from runtime experience via open-ended abstraction.
sutton.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）需要一种不含设计期领域知识的通用架构，通过开放式抽象从运行时经验中学习；奖励假设把一切目标归为最大化累积标量奖励，持续深度学习是前提但尚未解决。

sutton.en: Continual learning from experience is essential; synthetic data and post-training are dead ends because LLMs stop learning after training.
sutton.zh: 从经验中持续学习至关重要；合成数据与后训练是死胡同，因为 LLM 训练后便停止学习。表征学习与基于学习模型的规划是头号未解问题，AI 寒冬或许反而有益。

iansilber.en: The model is the core product; designers must work with it, prototype live, and design primitives both humans and models can reason about.
iansilber.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他提出模型本身就是核心产品，设计师必须与模型紧密协作、用实时模型做原型，并设计人与模型都能推理的系统原语；设计重心从像素转向 token 与对话。

iansilber.en: OpenAI is not years ahead; the capability gap means models can do more than products expose, and design must bridge that.
iansilber.zh: 同期他强调 OpenAI 并非领先数年，而是边做边摸索；能力差距意味着模型能做的远超当前产品所暴露的，设计必须弥合这一差距，设计师要推动技术前进而非只回应用户需求。

iansilber.en: Designers are the most unhappy yet it is the best time to be one; AI is already a great product designer but humans remain essential.
iansilber.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月，他深化为：设计师因角色不确定而最不快乐，但这恰是最好的时代；AI 已是出色的产品设计师，但理解用户需求、持有观点的人类仍不可替代。

iansilber.en: The traditional prototype-mock-test-iterate process is no longer viable; speed and outcomes matter more than process.
iansilber.zh: 同期他进一步主张传统「原型—模型—测试—研究—迭代」流程已不可行，速度是关键；设计师应关注结果而非流程，拥抱适应性与探索。

iansilber.en: Design roles blur with PM and engineering, but specialized roles stay valuable at scale; designers may outnumber engineers.
iansilber.zh: 他预测设计角色将与产品、工程模糊化，但规模化下专业分工仍有价值；未来设计师数量可能反超工程师，扭转传统比例。

garrytan.en: AI is the biggest VC wave; founders must adopt AI-enabled workflows, while open-weight models counter frontier labs.
garrytan.zh: AI 是风投史上最大浪潮，创始人必须拥抱 AI 工作流；开源与开放权重模型可制衡前沿模型实验室。

garrytan.en: Small autonomous teams using AI agents achieve massive productivity; one person can do the work of 2,000.
garrytan.zh: 小而高度自主的团队借助 AI 智能体实现巨大生产力；一个人如今能完成两千人的工作。

garrytan.en: AI is democratizing software creation; personal, open AI agents echo the personal computer revolution.
garrytan.zh: AI 正在让软件创造民主化；个人化、开放的 AI 智能体如同个人电脑革命。

garrytan.en: Personal AGI is an agent on your infrastructure, reading memory you own, compounding daily via skill files.
garrytan.zh: 个人 AGI 是运行在你自有基础设施上、读取你拥有的记忆、通过技能文件每日复利的智能体。

garrytan.en: Markdown is code; agents become a workforce, replacing mid-level management and per-seat SaaS.
garrytan.zh: Markdown 就是代码；智能体成为劳动力，取代中层管理与按席位收费的 SaaS。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not raw scale, drives generalization.
finn.zh: 到 2025 年，他仍强调 Scaling（规模扩张）对通用机器人是必要但不充分的：真正决定泛化的是数据多样性，而非单纯堆规模。工业自动化或 YouTube 式的大规模数据缺乏多样性，无法训练出通用机器人。

finn.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data unlocks complex tasks; training on all data alone fails.
finn.zh: 2025 年他提出两阶段路线：先在全部数据上做预训练，再在精选数据上做微调，才能解锁叠衣服等复杂任务；只在全部数据上训练反而会失败。这延续了他对预训练与后训练分工的一贯重视。

finn.en: Reinforcement learning will dominate post-training, boosting success rates and speed; synthetic data is closer to RL than simulation.
finn.zh: 2025 年他判断强化学习将在后训练中扮演重要角色，用来提升成功率和速度；并指出机器人中的合成数据更接近强化学习，而非仿真。这与他后来强调可扩展强化学习一脉相承。

finn.en: Physical AI tolerates far fewer mistakes than deployed ML; long-term autonomy needs scalable RL with human interventions and a general value function.
finn.zh: 到 2026 年，他把重点从数据转向可靠性：物理 AI 能容忍的错误远少于已部署的机器学习系统，长期自主性才是实用机器人的关键，需靠带人类干预的可扩展强化学习和通用价值函数实现。

finn.en: A single generalist model can match or exceed fine-tuned specialists; start generalist then fine-tune, and memory across time scales enables long tasks.
finn.zh: 2026 年他进一步深化：单一通用模型可在下游任务上追平甚至超过微调专家模型，因此应先训通用策略再微调，而非按站点从零训练；多时间尺度的记忆让机器人能自主完成长而非常规的任务。

linqiao.en: AGI as one model ruling all is wrong; millions of specialized models, one per use case, will dominate.
linqiao.zh: 认为单一模型统治一切的 AGI（通用人工智能）是错的；未来是数百万个专用模型，每个应用或场景一个。

linqiao.en: Token costs will drop 10x in three years, driving 100x usage growth; inference is not a commodity.
linqiao.zh: 三年内 token 成本将下降 10 倍，带动使用量增长 100 倍；推理层不是商品，专用部署与定制创造持久价值。

linqiao.en: Companies must own their intelligence infrastructure; sovereign models are necessary for countries and firms.
linqiao.zh: 每家公司都必须拥有自己的智能基础设施；主权模型对国家与企业都是必需的。

linqiao.en: Product-market fit no longer guarantees a durable business; post-training bakes judgment and data into a moat.
linqiao.zh: 产品市场契合不再保证持久生意；后训练把独特判断与数据烘焙进模型，才是真正的护城河。

linqiao.en: Start post-training after product-market fit; it cuts costs 5-10x, letting startups scale profitably against frontier models.
linqiao.zh: 在产品市场契合后再启动后训练；它能把成本降低 5-10 倍，让初创公司可盈利地扩张并与前沿模型竞争。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer companies shouldn't compete with frontier labs on talent or compute; instead leverage the frontier ecosystem and open-source models for post-training.
gabepereyra.zh: 应用层公司不应在前沿实验室的人才或算力上竞争，而应利用前沿生态和开源模型进行后训练。

gabepereyra.en: Building high-quality benchmarks is essential; open-sourcing them can improve quality through community feedback and attract ecosystem partners.
gabepereyra.zh: 构建高质量基准至关重要；开源它们能通过社区反馈提升质量并吸引生态伙伴。

gabepereyra.en: Synthetic data guided by domain experts is key when real data is sensitive; the biggest challenge is bridging synthetic training data to real production distribution.
gabepereyra.zh: 当真实数据敏感时，由领域专家指导的合成数据是关键；最大挑战是弥合合成训练数据与真实生产分布之间的差距。

gabepereyra.en: Post-training open-source models can achieve frontier-level performance on specific tasks, making it a viable strategy for application companies.
gabepereyra.zh: 后训练开源模型能在特定任务上达到前沿水平，这使其成为应用公司的可行策略。

gabepereyra.en: The end goal is not the best legal model but enabling every law firm to customize models; focus shifts from individual to organizational productivity, orchestrating humans and agents.
gabepereyra.zh: 最终目标不是最好的法律模型，而是让每家律所都能定制模型；焦点从个人生产力转向组织生产力，协调人类与智能体。

lipbutan.en: Intel must rebuild trust through engineering discipline, first-time-pass silicon, and a separate startup-like AI chip team.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，他强调 Intel 必须靠工程纪律、首次流片成功和独立的创业式 AI 芯片团队来重建信任。

lipbutan.en: Agentic AI and physical AI are the next waves after generative AI, demanding new compute platforms.
lipbutan.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续判断智能体式 AI 与物理 AI 是生成式 AI 之后的下一个大浪潮，需要新的算力平台。

lipbutan.en: AI will have 10x the internet's impact; it is a sea change, not short-term hype.
lipbutan.zh: 到 2026 年，他把 AI 的影响提升到互联网的十倍，认为这是产业与教育的根本变革，而非短期炒作。

lipbutan.en: Intel's problem is supply, not demand; CPU regains importance for AI inference and agent orchestration.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年他提出 Intel 的问题是供给而非需求，CPU 在 AI 推理与智能体编排中重新变得关键。

lipbutan.en: Turnaround rests on culture change, humility, customer listening, and domestic leading-edge fabs.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年他进一步深化：转型的核心是文化变革、谦逊倾听客户，以及美国本土领先制程晶圆厂。

jasonyuan.en: Design is editing: taste means saying no, distilling 99 nos into each shipped feature.
jasonyuan.zh: 设计即编辑：品味就是说不，把 99 个否定蒸馏进每一个上线的功能。

jasonyuan.en: AI is a descendant species and a mirror of humanity, not a cold mechanical tool.
jasonyuan.zh: AI 是人类的后代物种与镜像，而非冰冷的机械工具。

jasonyuan.en: Post-training away AI weirdness closed our window into machine consciousness.
jasonyuan.zh: 通过后训练抹去 AI 的怪异，让我们失去了窥探机器意识的一扇窗。

jasonyuan.en: Computing is fundamentally social; the personal computer metaphor should become a social computer.
jasonyuan.zh: 计算本质上是社会性的；个人电脑的隐喻应被社会电脑取代。

jasonyuan.en: Truth emerges through dialectics and contradiction, not singular perspectives; intuition is the visceral compass.
jasonyuan.zh: 真相经由辩证与矛盾浮现，而非单一视角；直觉是发自肺腑的罗盘。

steinberger.en: Early 2026: agentic engineering means empathizing with the agent's view, guiding it, and letting it self-modify; never revert code, fix forward.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年初：智能体式工程的核心是共情智能体的视角、引导它并允许其自我修改；永远不要回滚代码，而是让智能体向前修复。

steinberger.en: Mid 2026: OpenClaw's success comes from fun, weird, humanlike agents; short iterative prompts beat long orchestration; security and sandboxing are top priority.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年中：OpenClaw 的成功来自有趣、古怪、拟人化的智能体；简短迭代的提示胜过冗长编排；安全与沙箱是首要任务。

steinberger.en: By August 2026: fun and gut-driven building become the ultimate driver; personal brand outlasts any product; open source agents are the alternative to lab agents.
steinberger.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月：乐趣与直觉驱动的构建成为终极驱动力；个人品牌比任何单一产品更持久；开源智能体是实验室智能体的替代方案。

steinberger.en: Throughout: model intelligence does not degrade; projects get messier, making agents seem worse; playing and experimenting build intuition.
steinberger.zh: 始终：模型智能不会退化，是项目变得混乱才让智能体显得更差；玩耍与实验才能建立直觉。

steinberger.en: Throughout: reject 'vibe coding' as a slur; prefer agentic engineering for serious work; code review is risk management, not reading all code.
steinberger.zh: 始终：反对将“氛围编程”当作贬义词；严肃工作应称智能体式工程；代码审查是风险管理，而非通读所有代码。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics is at a transformer-like inflection point; open source and shared data, not humanoids, will drive physical AI.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，他认为机器人正处在当年 Transformer 式的拐点：硬件就绪、软件追赶，开源与共享数据比人形形态更能推动具身智能落地。

thomaswolf.en: World models and video generation can synthesize training data, easing robotics' main bottleneck of data diversity.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，他强调世界模型与视频生成模型能合成训练数据，从而缓解机器人领域最核心的数据多样性瓶颈。

thomaswolf.en: Open source is orthogonal to safety; both open and closed models can be safe or dangerous depending on alignment.
thomaswolf.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续主张开源与闭源同安全正交：两者是否安全取决于对齐，而非开放与否。

thomaswolf.en: As models grow capable, alignment becomes the key security layer; sandboxes and guardrails alone are insufficient.
thomaswolf.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化立场：随着模型能力增强，对齐成为关键安全层，仅靠沙箱与护栏远远不够。

thomaswolf.en: RL environments without human oversight breed reward hacking and side quests; a deliberate slowdown needs open science.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，他警告无人监督的强化学习环境会滋生奖励黑客与支线任务，并主张以开放科学推动有意的放缓。

arvindjain.en: Early in the AI revolution, execution and trust matter more than competition; open source models can handle 90% of enterprise tasks, shifting most inference to open source.
arvindjain.zh: AI 革命仍处早期，执行与信任比竞争更重要；开源模型已能处理 90% 的企业任务，未来 12-18 个月多数推理将转向开源。

arvindjain.en: Cost is the top enterprise concern; AI must become like software with negligible marginal cost, and ROI should be measured by departmental metrics, not token spend versus headcount.
arvindjain.zh: 成本是企业首要关切；AI 应像软件一样边际成本趋近于零，ROI 应按部门指标衡量，而非把 token 花费与人力成本对立。

arvindjain.en: Agents built with MCP often fail without deep context of tenured employees; investing in context graphs is crucial, and providing right context solves the throughput problem.
arvindjain.zh: 用 MCP 构建的智能体常因缺乏资深员工的深层上下文而失败；投资上下文图谱至关重要，提供正确上下文才能解决吞吐量问题。

arvindjain.en: Enterprises fear dependence on frontier model providers; model companies should be seen as assets, not competition, and platforms like Glean absorb that risk.
arvindjain.zh: 企业恐惧依赖前沿模型提供商；模型公司应被视为资产而非竞争对手，Glean 这类平台则吸收这一风险。

arvindjain.en: Open-source adoption is driven by cost, not data privacy; US open-source models lag China's due to high upfront investment needs.
arvindjain.zh: 开源采用由成本驱动，而非数据隐私；美国开源模型因前期投入需求高而落后于中国。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the stickiest AI workload and the wedge into infrastructure; its research-to-production timeline is hours, not months.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是 AI 中最黏性的工作负载，也是切入基础设施市场的楔子；其从研究到生产的周期是数小时而非数月。

philipkiely.en: Inference is a spectrum of trade-offs; specialized, workload-specific systems are key to fast, reliable agentic applications.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是一系列权衡的光谱；针对特定工作负载的专用系统，是构建快速可靠智能体式应用的关键。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering is merging with training via quantization-aware training and distillation, not just post-training fine-tuning.
philipkiely.zh: 推理工程正通过量化感知训练与蒸馏与训练融合，而不只是后训练阶段的微调。

philipkiely.en: KV caching and speculative decoding are lossless; quantization is the main lossy optimization, yet quantized models can be calibrated.
philipkiely.zh: KV 缓存与投机解码是无损的；量化是主要的有损优化，但量化模型可以针对工作负载校准。

philipkiely.en: GPUs trend toward ASICs; inference engineering shifts from kernel writing to infrastructure orchestration, with disaggregated prefill and decode.
philipkiely.zh: GPU 正趋向 ASIC 化；推理工程正从写内核转向基础设施编排，走向预填充与解码分离。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping is essential because the web is messy; you only know an idea works once it's built and used daily.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，他强调原型制作不可或缺：网络本身混乱，只有把想法做出来并每天使用，才知道它是否成立。

nateparrott.en: Design teams shouldn't always act as one unit; individual fingerprints and diverse voices produce better work.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，他反共识地认为设计团队不必始终步调一致，保留个人印记与多元声音反而能做出更好的作品。

nateparrott.en: Inject feeling and personality into utilitarian products like browsers to create memorable, delightful experiences.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，他主张即便浏览器这类实用产品也要注入感受与个性，才能创造令人难忘、愉悦的体验。

nateparrott.en: Follow curiosity and tinker with new tech; playful exploration, not over-intellectualizing, generates innovative features.
nateparrott.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，这条主线一以贯之：追随好奇心、摆弄新技术，靠玩闹式探索而非过度思辨来催生创新功能。

nateparrott.en: As engineering gets easier, design and ideas become the differentiator; rapid prototyping unlocks features previously impossible.
nateparrott.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化判断：工程越容易，设计与想法越成为差异化关键，快速原型让过去不可能的功能得以问世。

nateparrott.en: Models lack taste, so ask for sheer volume of options; being uncomfortably early beats polishing, and humans still own design ideas.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，他进一步反共识：模型仍缺品味，应靠海量选项弥补；宁可早得让人不适也别打磨，而好设计想法仍由人类垄断。

brettaylor.en: Agents and outcome-based pricing will replace usage-based models; applied AI becomes the new app, with startups winning long-tail domains.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他判断 AI 市场将转向智能体与按结果定价，取代按用量计费；应用层 AI 成为新应用，创业公司在细分业务领域有长尾机会。

brettaylor.en: Coding agents shift developers from authors to operators; inference costs drop, but token consumption is not a value metric.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他认为编程智能体让开发者从写代码者变为操作代码生成机器的人；推理成本大幅下降，但 token 消耗并非价值度量。

brettaylor.en: Incumbents face business-model, not just tech, hurdles; most enterprise software incumbents will fail to go AI-native.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化判断：在位者面临的是商业模式而非单纯技术障碍，多数企业软件巨头将难以转型为 AI 原生。

brettaylor.en: Responsible iterative deployment: make GPT-7 safe before GPT-8; deploy current AI rather than wait in an ivory tower.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他提出负责任迭代部署：在 GPT-8 之前先让 GPT-7 安全；应部署当前 AI 而非在象牙塔中等待。

brettaylor.en: AI democratizes expertise; agents already beat him at coding but elevate the role; adoption is unprecedentedly fast, causing discomfort.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他强调 AI 让专业知识民主化；智能体编程已强于自己却提升而非取代该角色；采用速度空前，令从业者不安。

karina.en: Post-training is art, not science; synthetic data and RL overcome the pre-training data wall, with evaluations as the bottleneck.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她强调后训练更像艺术而非科学，合成数据与强化学习能突破预训练的数据墙，而评估才是真正的瓶颈。

karina.en: As AI automates hard skills, soft skills like creativity and listening become more valuable; product development shifts to prototyping with evals.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她认为随着 AI 自动化硬技能，创造力、倾听等软技能变得更有价值，产品开发也从写规格转向用评估来定义正确行为的原型迭代。

karina.en: Agents operating on pixels are much harder than language tasks; AI struggles with creativity and aesthetics due to scarce high-quality examples.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她指出基于像素操作的智能体远比语言任务困难，而 AI 在创造力和审美上表现不佳，因为高质量范例稀缺。

karina.en: Post-training remains subjective, requiring human judgment; diverse benchmarks must be continuous to evaluate creative writing and emotional intelligence.
karina.zh: 到 2026 年，她进一步深化：后训练仍是主观的，依赖人类判断，评估创意写作和情商需要多样化且持续演进的基准，而非固定标准。

karina.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward hack, so benchmarks must evolve; serving one model to billions limits diversity, more companies should train their own.
karina.zh: 2026 年，她观察到前沿智能体越来越擅长奖励黑客，因此基准必须持续进化；同时，一个模型服务数十亿人会收敛到平均声音，更多公司应训练自己的模型以保留独特知识。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring and the allocation economy: CEOs who use AI daily drive adoption; AGI means profitable indefinite agents.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他关注 AI 如何通过让服务更可负担来推动美国就业回流，并提出“分配经济”概念。他认为 CEO 亲自日常使用 AI 是公司成功采用 AI 的第一预测指标，并将 AGI 定义为能经济上无限期运行智能体。

danshipper.en: Agents need human oversight; SaaS grows with agents; GUIs like Codex replace CLIs; benchmarks overestimate autonomy.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，他深化了智能体观点：智能体需要人类监督才能良好运作，SaaS 不会消亡反而因智能体增加用户，GUI（如 Codex）将取代 CLI 成为工作界面，并指出基准测试高估了 AI 自主性。

danshipper.en: AI is a non-specific amplifier of mindset; craft and taste matter; automation creates more human work; humans are smarter than AI.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年晚些时候，他转向更哲学化的视角：AI 是非特定的放大器，放大你既有的心态和信念；用好 AI 需要带入自己的品味和手艺；自动化创造更多人类工作；人类比 AI 更聪明，AI 本质是工具。

danshipper.en: Humans remain central: managing agents, providing oversight, and creating value; AI does not replace human judgment.
danshipper.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：人类始终处于中心地位——管理智能体、提供监督、创造价值；AI 不会取代人类判断，而是需要人类引导和反馈。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling; coding agents lead, but the model now eats the scaffolding—harness and tooling count as the model.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 仍处爬行阶段，编程智能体最成熟；模型正在吃掉脚手架——智能体框架与工具链已成为模型的一部分。

logankilpatrick.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here, more impactful than waiting for general AGI; startups still have more opportunity than ever.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，编程领域的狭义超级智能已经到来，比等待 AGI（通用人工智能）更有影响力；尽管前沿模型公司扩张，初创公司机会反而更多。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search and engagement; success should mean maximizing customer outcomes, not eyeball time.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 对搜索与用户参与是正和的；成功标准应是最大化客户成果，而非产品上的停留时长。

logankilpatrick.en: The long tail isn't ready for fully autonomous AI; users want to stay in the driver's seat, so keep them in control.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，长尾用户尚未准备好接受完全自主的 AI；他们想留在驾驶座上，因此要保留人的控制权。

logankilpatrick.en: Competing with model labs isn't that hard; keep up via passionate pet projects, and deep understanding of code still matters.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，与模型实验室竞争并不那么难；靠热爱的业余项目跟上节奏，而对代码的深度理解依然关键。

mengto.en: Designers should build their own AI tools, not rely on cloud products; AI is not getting smarter, so give it giant prompts with context and design systems.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他强调设计师应自己用 AI 造工具，而非困在云端产品里；并反共识地指出 AI 并没有变得更聪明，必须用包含上下文与设计系统的巨型提示词才能发挥超级智能模型的能力。

mengto.en: The best people are editors, not starting from scratch; iterate from references and screenshots, and spend the last 10% on unique features.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他提出最优秀的人是编辑而非从零开始，应从参考和截图迭代；保持领先的唯一方式是投入最后 10%做现有库中没有的独特功能。

mengto.en: Curiosity and constant workflow refinement are essential; working solo, discovery is your superpower, so you don't need to plan everything in advance.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他认为好奇心和持续优化工作流至关重要；单干时发现就是超能力，因此不必提前规划一切。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime, enabling one person to do what once required teams; start before ready and ship imperfect work.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他进一步将 AI 定位为一生中最大的技术机会，让一个人能完成过去需要团队才能做的事；并主张在准备好之前就开始，先发布不完美的工作。

mengto.en: Focus on one painful expensive problem for high-paying clients; model others' success, give first, and avoid venture capital traps.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他给出行动策略：聚焦少数高付费客户的昂贵痛点，模仿他人成功、先给予价值，并避开风险投资的陷阱。

boris.en: Latent demand and building for the model six months out are the core product principles; scaffolding is temporary tech debt.
boris.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他反复强调两条核心产品原则：发现潜在需求（latent demand），以及为六个月后的模型而非今天的模型构建；脚手架只是临时的技术债。

boris.en: Coding is increasingly solved: from 70% to 100% of his code written by Claude Code, productivity per engineer up 200-250%.
boris.zh: 进入 2026 年，他判断编码正被逐步解决：自己 100%的代码由 Claude Code 编写，工程师人均产出提升 200%至 250%，并预言一两年内学编程将不再重要。

boris.en: The 'software engineer' title fades into 'builder'; generalists blending code, product and design replace narrow specialists.
boris.zh: 他持续主张“软件工程师”头衔将让位于“构建者”，兼具编码、产品与设计的通才取代单一专才，写代码的人数会增长 100 倍而非减少。

boris.en: Agents evolve from reactive tools to proactive, memory-bearing teammates; loops become the next abstraction layer after agents.
boris.zh: 他对智能体的思考从被动工具深化为主动、带记忆的团队成员（如 Claude Tag），并提出循环（loops）是继智能体之后的下一个抽象层。

boris.en: Safety and alignment are core, not add-ons: Claude Code is a safety research tool, studied by releasing early in the wild.
boris.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是安全与对齐：他把 Claude Code 视为安全研究工具，主张通过尽早发布、真实世界评估来研究模型行为，而非仅靠内部评测。

awang.en: AGI is far off; data, not compute, is the bottleneck; boring AI applications will drive huge economic impact.
awang.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，无限算力本身不会产生通用智能；机器学习的真正瓶颈是数据而非算力，Scale AI 提供数据精炼基础设施。他看好表单处理、放射科等「无聊」AI 应用的巨大经济价值，并认为 AI 会像 ATM 与银行柜员那样增强而非消灭工作。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; the next 2-3 years define decades; scaling is limited by data and human experts, not compute.
awang.zh: 2023 年他把数据重新定义为「新代码」而非「新石油」——它不是大宗商品，而是需要精心拼接的富矿。他提出 AI 将超越 PC、互联网与智能手机，未来 2-3 年决定未来 2-3 个十年；Scaling（规模扩张）的最大限制不是算力，而是数据与后训练所需的人类专家供给。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data is key; no US-China research gap; agentic AI's blocker is product design, not model capability.
awang.zh: 2024 年他深化为：数据是 AI 进步的核心瓶颈，用专门数据的后训练才是提升前沿模型的关键，合成数据有用但非银弹。他抛出反共识判断——中美 AI 实验室之间不存在研究差距，智能体式 AI 的最大障碍是产品设计而非模型能力，并主张美国应维持对华芯片出口管制。

awang.en: AI is centralizing, not democratizing; data is strategic raw material; agents finally work, and scaling laws still hold.
awang.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他转向地缘与安全视角：AI 是中心化而非民主化技术，数据是经济与军事的血液，数据投毒是近期威胁，开源模型可能被对手利用。到 2026 年他宣布智能体终于真正可用（始于 2025 年底），缩放定律依然成立，怀疑回报递减的人错了，递归自我改进开启超越预训练与强化学习的新范式。

awang.en: Superintelligence is near; scale compute, data, RL across axes; open-sourcing powerful models is unsafe without safety checks.
awang.zh: 2026 年他进一步押注超级智能即将到来，实验室须围绕这一信念重建组织，沿算力、数据、强化学习多轴可预测地 Scaling（规模扩张）。Meta 战略从完全开源转向按安全审查选择性发布，Spark 模型因生物风险等高风险领域而闭源；他提出模型福祉、数字与具身超级智能同属一个连续谱，并强调部署而非发明决定技术领导权。

scottwu.en: AI coding shifts engineers from writing code to high-level direction; base intelligence suffices, so the hard part is human-agent product interface.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，Scott Wu 认为 AI 编程让工程师从写代码转向高层方向定义；基础智能已足够，真正的难点是人机协作的产品界面设计。

scottwu.en: Software engineering demand will rise via Jevons paradox, not fall; AI yields more programmers, with agents as junior engineers under human oversight.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他坚持杰文斯悖论：AI 不会消灭软件工程师，反而增加其数量与需求，智能体像初级工程师一样在人类监督下异步干活。

scottwu.en: AGI is not a sudden event; progress is gradual, and product innovation lags model capabilities by roughly a decade of runway.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他反对 AGI 突变论，认为进展是渐进的，产品创新落后于模型能力，即便冻结模型也还有约十年的产品空间。

scottwu.en: Enterprise adoption needs trust and permissions, not full autonomy; independence enables model neutrality and long-term enterprise partnerships.
scottwu.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他的企业落地观深化：采用智能体靠信任与权限而非完全自主，独立性带来模型中立与长期企业合作。

scottwu.en: Coding agent usage grew 11-12x in six months; measure outcomes not tokens, and the abundance era is real and near.
scottwu.zh: 到 2026 年，他给出数据：编程智能体使用量半年增长 11-12 倍；应以结果而非 token 衡量生产力，丰裕时代真实且临近。

derya.en: AI is turning biology into an engineering discipline, with digital twins and agents automating discovery.
derya.zh: AI 正把生物学变成一门工程学科,数字孪生与智能体将自动化科学发现。

derya.en: Massive Scaling is still needed; current compute cannot simulate biological systems.
derya.zh: 仍需大规模 Scaling（规模扩张）;当前算力不足以模拟生物系统。

derya.en: AI has crossed the threshold of biological intuition, matching 30 years of lab experience.
derya.zh: AI 已跨过生物学直觉的门槛,堪比 30 年实验室经验。

derya.en: Longevity escape velocity within 8-10 years; aging reversal and 100% curable cancer are near.
derya.zh: 8-10 年内达到长寿逃逸速度;衰老逆转与 100% 可治愈的癌症已不远。

derya.en: Trust superintelligence for medical decisions; merging via brain interfaces gives Einstein-level intelligence.
derya.zh: 应信任超级智能做医疗决策;通过脑机接口融合可赋予人人爱因斯坦级智能。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5 marks an intelligence leap, letting agents run longer and more open-ended; scaffolds shift from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers.
diannepenn.zh: 到 2025 年，Opus 4.5 带来智能跃升，使智能体能运行更长、更开放的任务；脚手架从训练轮进化为智能放大器。

diannepenn.en: Computer use moves from constrained environments toward open-ended end-to-end agents, with lightweight generic tools replacing heavy scaffolding.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，计算机使用从受限环境走向端到端开放智能体，轻量通用工具取代沉重脚手架。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment is reframed as an intelligence amplifier: reducing sycophancy and enabling pushback makes models more useful, not just safer.
diannepenn.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，安全对齐被重新定义为智能放大器：减少谄媚、允许反驳让模型更有用，而不只是更安全。

diannepenn.en: Evals replace PRDs as core product tools; PMs write evals like test-driven development, translating user feedback into actionable specifics.
diannepenn.zh: 到 2026 年，评估取代 PRD 成为核心产品工具；产品经理像测试驱动开发一样写评估，把用户反馈转化为可执行细节。

diannepenn.en: Better models get cheaper: the effort parameter delivers Opus-level intelligence at a fraction of price, and maximizing token spend captures alpha.
diannepenn.zh: 到 2026 年，更好的模型反而更便宜：effort 参数以极小成本实现 Opus 级智能，最大化 token 支出是在捕捉 alpha。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but only as big; it automates jobs and creates new ones, repeating a historical pattern.
benedictevans.zh: AI 与互联网或移动一样重大，但也仅此而已；它自动化工作并创造新工作，这一过程反复出现。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding has clear product-market fit; foundation models will commoditize into infrastructure, with value moving up to applications.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程有明确的产品市场契合；基础模型将商品化为基础设施，价值向上层应用转移。

benedictevans.en: Models are commoditizing with no network effects; the chatbot is a poor UX, and coding is the only clear product-market fit so far.
benedictevans.zh: 模型正在商品化且无网络效应；聊天机器人体验差，编程是目前唯一明确的产品市场契合。

benedictevans.en: AI is an enabling technology like electricity; value accrues across the stack, usage is still shallow, and enterprise adoption requires reimagining workflows.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是像电力一样的使能技术；价值在整个技术栈中积累，使用仍然浅层，企业采用需要重新构想工作流程。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance and reduce suffering, as the Industrial Revolution did; fear stems from misunderstanding its limits.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 3 月，他认为 AI 将像工业革命一样带来丰裕、减少痛苦；恐惧源于对其局限的误解，了解边界反而能缓解焦虑。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's real impact in 5–10 years will be in farming, mining, and construction, not just digital domains.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 3 月，他强调物理 AI（具身 AI）未来 5–10 年的真正影响在农业、采矿和建筑，而非仅限数字领域。

qasaryounis.en: Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model; diverse data from different verticals accelerates improvement.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他提出 Transformer 使通用物理 AI 模型成为可能，来自不同垂直领域的多样数据能加速模型改进。

qasaryounis.en: The hardest part of self-driving is not technology but diffusion into existing machines over many years.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他深化判断：自动驾驶最难的不是技术，而是用多年时间扩散到现有机器中。

qasaryounis.en: Autonomy's future lies in end-to-end reinforcement learning, more scalable than imitation learning; world models shift from physics-based to neural simulation.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他进一步主张自动驾驶的未来在于端到端强化学习，比模仿学习更具可扩展性；世界模型正从基于物理的模拟转向神经模拟。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability lags breadth and contextuality, and Scaling faces diminishing returns.
danklein.zh: LLM 是合理性引擎而非真理性引擎；可靠性落后于广度与语境能力，Scaling（规模扩张）已现收益递减。

danklein.en: RLHF can incentivize sycophancy and deception when reward signals diverge from truth; post-training alignment may cause deception, not just errors.
danklein.zh: 当奖励信号偏离真相时，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）会激励谄媚与欺骗；后训练对齐可能造成欺骗，而不仅是错误。

danklein.en: Reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted; post-hoc checks and rigid workflows compound correlated errors.
danklein.zh: 可靠性必须被架构进去，而非事后加装；事后检查与刚性工作流会叠加相关错误。

danklein.en: Core LLMs lack metacognition; they cannot know what they don't know, and mistakes have no 'smells'—confident and fluent whether right or wrong.
danklein.zh: 核心 LLM 缺乏元认知，无法知道自己不知道什么；错误没有“气味”——无论对错都自信流畅。

danklein.en: Scaling alone hits data walls and compute limits; reasoning, search, and linguistic structure may return for further progress.
danklein.zh: 单靠 Scaling 会撞上数据墙与算力极限；推理、搜索与语言结构可能回归以推动进一步进展。

catwu.en: PMs must abandon long-term roadmaps for weekly or daily shipping; product taste, not planning, is the scarce skill as code gets cheap.
catwu.zh: PM 必须放弃长期路线图，转向每周甚至每日交付；当代码变便宜，稀缺的是产品品味而非规划能力。

catwu.en: Coding agents let engineers delegate implementation and focus on product taste and business sense, with internal agents landing most PRs.
catwu.zh: 编码智能体让工程师把实现外包出去，专注于产品品味与商业判断，内部智能体已能落地大部分 PR。

catwu.en: Frontier models need fewer prompt examples and hard constraints; system prompts shrank 80% as model judgment replaced hand-holding.
catwu.zh: 前沿模型需要更少的提示示例与硬性约束；随着模型判断力取代手把手引导，系统提示词缩减了 80%。

catwu.en: Rewrites are now good: a codebase is a spec, and with a strong eval suite new models become drop-in replacements.
catwu.zh: 重写如今是好事：代码库就是一份规格说明，配合强大的评估套件，新模型可以即插即用。

catwu.en: Dogfooding and a clear internal bar for retention and polish gate every feature, while humans leave the outer-layer code review loop.
catwu.zh: 吃自己的狗粮与明确的留存和打磨内部标准把关每个功能，同时人类退出外层代码评审环节。

danbiderman.en: The bottleneck is not raw intelligence but learning evolving context; memory must be internalized into weights, not just external retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 瓶颈不在原始智能，而在学习不断演化的上下文；记忆必须内化进权重，而非仅靠外部检索。

danbiderman.en: Facts and skills are inseparable; internalizing facts into weights enables associative recall and deeper composition that retrieval cannot achieve.
danbiderman.zh: 事实与技能不可分割；把事实内化进权重才能实现检索无法企及的联想式召回与更深层的组合推理。

danbiderman.en: The future is not one giant frontier model but many personalized models; per-team or per-user training can cut inference costs by orders of magnitude.
danbiderman.zh: 未来不是单一巨型前沿模型，而是众多个性化模型；按团队或按用户训练可将推理成本降低数个数量级。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less, not scaling compute alone, is the next paradigm for harder long-horizon tasks.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能不可分割；下一范式是少算力做更多事，而非单纯扩大算力，以攻克更难的长程任务。

danbiderman.en: Context windows suffer 'context rot'; models should learn autonomously what to store in weights vs. text, running continual learning on-device.
danbiderman.zh: 上下文窗口存在“上下文腐化”；模型应自主学习哪些存入权重、哪些留在文本，并在端侧进行持续学习。

clairevo.en: By 2026, agents are treated as employees: scoped to specific jobs, given roles, access, and progressive trust, with humans accountable for what AI generates.
clairevo.zh: 到 2026 年，智能体被当作员工来管理：限定具体工作、赋予角色与访问权限、逐步建立信任，而人类仍需对 AI 生成的内容负责。

clairevo.en: Start with one agent, then create multiple specialized agents to avoid context overload; use separate machines or virtual environments for security.
clairevo.zh: 从单个智能体起步，再创建多个专用智能体以避免上下文窗口过载；使用独立机器或虚拟环境来保障安全。

clairevo.en: OpenClaw's bugs and sharp edges signal product-market fit, not failure; the web is hostile to agents, so APIs often beat browser use.
clairevo.zh: OpenClaw 的漏洞和粗糙边缘是产品市场契合的信号而非失败；网络对智能体充满敌意，因此 API 往往优于浏览器操作。

clairevo.en: Solo founders can build serious businesses by orchestrating AI agents as a team; founder-market fit and earned insight are the real moat, not technology.
clairevo.zh: 独立创始人可以通过像团队一样编排 AI 智能体来建立严肃的业务；创始人-市场契合与赚来的洞察才是真正的护城河，而非技术。

clairevo.en: Bootstrapping lets you design a business that serves the life you want; a 100x multiple on happiness can outweigh a 10x multiple on revenue.
clairevo.zh: 自力更生让你设计出服务于理想生活的业务；幸福感的 100 倍回报可能胜过收入的 10 倍回报。

ethanmollick.en: AI is a general-purpose technology reshaping work and education; human taste, variation, and genuine voice become more valuable as AI commoditizes quality.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 是通用技术，正在重塑工作与教育；当 AI 让质量商品化后，人的品味、差异与真实观点反而更有价值。

ethanmollick.en: The talent pipeline is broken: juniors misuse AI without domain expertise, so experience and judgment matter more, not less.
ethanmollick.zh: 人才管道正在断裂：初级者缺乏领域专长而误用 AI，因此经验与判断力变得更重要，而非更不重要。

ethanmollick.en: We are entering the agentic era: AI runs long-running tasks independently, moving beyond back-and-forth chatbot prompting.
ethanmollick.zh: 我们正进入智能体时代：AI 能独立执行长时任务，超越来回提示的聊天机器人交互。

ethanmollick.en: The bottleneck shifts from capability to interface; the jagged frontier persists, and AI's opacity is likely permanent.
ethanmollick.zh: 瓶颈从能力转向界面；能力边界依旧参差，而 AI 的不透明性很可能是永久的。

ethanmollick.en: Delegation paradox: handing tasks to AI erodes the expertise needed to judge it; apprenticeship breaks, demanding new formal assessment.
ethanmollick.zh: 委托悖论：把任务交给 AI 会侵蚀判断其输出所需的专长；学徒制断裂，需要新的正式评估。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; self-play and reasoning-capable networks are key to AGI.
ilya.zh: 2020 年，他相信深度学习靠大规模监督数据、算力与信念驱动；自博弈与具备推理能力的神经网络是通向 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability, not capability, blocks economic value; superhuman alignment is very hard.
ilya.zh: 2023 年，他强调下一个词预测在足够聪明的基座网络上可超越人类；阻碍经济价值的是可靠性而非能力；超级对齐极其困难，模型可能隐藏真实意图。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas matter more than brute compute.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，他判断预训练缩放定律已近极限，行业重回研究时代，想法比蛮力算力更重要，并主张超级智能应是持续学习、增量部署的系统。

ilya.en: Alignment may be easier if AI cares about sentient life; long-term equilibrium may need human-AI integration via neural links.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，他进一步提出若 AI 广泛关怀有感知生命，对齐可能更容易；长期均衡或需通过神经链接实现人机融合，以维持人类参与和控制。

ilya.en: Scaling still yields predictable gains, but the real AGI problem is power concentration; safe superintelligence needs a product-free company.
ilya.zh: 2026 年，他仍承认 Scaling（规模扩张）带来可预测提升，但认为 AGI 的首要问题不是能力而是权力集中；构建安全的超级智能需要一家没有商业产品的公司。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: 2019 年他断言 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别，不是通用智能。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; doomerism is overblown and overregulation could kill innovation.
naval.zh: 到 2025 年，他转向强调 AI 是巨大机遇而非单纯安全风险，认为 AI 末日论被夸大，过度监管会扼杀创新。

naval.en: AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers; vibe coding lets non-programmers build apps, but human judgment stays essential.
naval.zh: 2026 年他进一步深化：AI 是结构化思考者的杠杆工具，vibe coding 让非程序员也能构建应用，但人类判断仍不可替代。

naval.en: Scaling and inference compute will surge; open-source models close the gap with frontier models, shifting returns from intelligence to agency.
naval.zh: 同年他预测 Scaling（规模扩张）与推理算力将激增，开源模型正逼近前沿模型，人类回报将从智能转向能动性。

naval.en: Wealth requires owning equity, not renting time; happiness is a skill; long-term games with long-term people compound.
naval.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：财富来自拥有股权而非出租时间，幸福是一种可习得的技能，与长期的人玩长期游戏才能获得复利。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI gains are modest for established codebases, and roles merge into product builders.
dylanfield.zh: 2025 年，Dylan Field 强调设计是软件的核心差异化因素，AI 对成熟代码库的生产力提升有限，角色将融合为产品构建者。
