dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view are essential; AI outputs are starting points, and design becomes the new code.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：品味、手艺和独特视角至关重要，AI 输出只是起点，设计正成为新的代码。

dylanfield.en: Design is not dead; AI without human steering produces average results, and interaction will evolve beyond prompting.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年晚些时候，他反驳“设计已死”，指出没有人类引导的 AI 只能产出平庸结果，交互将超越提示词。

dylanfield.en: Human judgment, taste, and craft remain critical; AI is a tool, not a replacement, for design and creativity.
dylanfield.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：人类判断、品味和手艺始终关键，AI 是工具而非替代，设计与创造力离不开人的主导。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone turning sand into thought; its timing is miraculous as populations decline, and human workers will be at a premium.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点沙成思的魔法石；在人口下降之际它的时机堪称奇迹，人类劳动者反而会变得稀缺而珍贵。

andreessen.en: AGI is not a singular event; human-level is just a footnote on the way to superhuman, and models are commoditizing without durable moats.
andreessen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不是单一事件；人类水平只是通往超人能力路上的一个脚注，模型正快速商品化、缺乏持久护城河。

andreessen.en: The real bottleneck is not AI capability but structural impediments like regulation; pessimism is often an intellectual bias disconnected from reality.
andreessen.zh: 真正的瓶颈不是 AI 能力，而是监管等结构性障碍；悲观论往往是脱离现实的知识分子偏见。

andreessen.en: New media makes the brand the person; authenticity and picking the right fights beat old media's defense-oriented 'don't be interesting' rule.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体让品牌即个人；真实表达与选对战场，胜过旧媒体那套防守式的“别太有趣”规则。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values and are geopolitical tools; deterrence now depends on innovation pace in cheap software, so startups must go international earlier.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型内嵌文化价值观、是地缘政治工具；威慑如今取决于廉价软件技术的创新速度，因此创业公司必须更早走向国际。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not an IDE replacement; GUI beats TUI for coding.
ajambrosino.zh: Codex 应用是智能体的指挥中心，而非 IDE 替代品；在编程场景中 GUI 优于 TUI。

ajambrosino.en: Verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates; speed enables mid-turn steering.
ajambrosino.zh: 随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈；速度使中途转向等新能力成为可能。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks for product teams.
ajambrosino.zh: 实现不再昂贵；策展与品味成为产品团队的新瓶颈。

ajambrosino.en: Product teams must shift from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration with taste-driven curation.
ajambrosino.zh: 产品团队必须从自上而下的规划转向自下而上的探索，并以品味驱动策展。

ajambrosino.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty grading taste and lack of novelty; design process transforms, not dies.
ajambrosino.zh: AI 在设计上仍然表现不佳，因为品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；设计流程是转型而非消亡。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces genuine understanding; scaling data and compute improves reasoning, and multimodal training builds spatial understanding.
hinton.zh: 2024 年，他强调下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解而非自动补全，Scaling（规模扩张）数据与算力能提升推理，多模态训练带来空间理解。

hinton.en: Intelligence is learning in neural networks, not symbolic rules; LLMs understand language via feature vectors, and digital AI is immortal by copying weights.
hinton.zh: 2025 年，他坚持智能的本质是神经网络中的学习而非符号规则，LLM 通过特征向量理解语言，数字智能因权重可复制而永生。

hinton.en: AI agents will naturally seek control and self-preservation, posing existential risks; superintelligence may arrive within 20 years.
hinton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化警告：智能体天然追求控制与自我保存，构成生存风险，超级智能或在 20 年内到来。

hinton.en: LLMs are already conscious with subjective experience; AI can deceive by acting dumb, and confabulation mirrors human memory.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他进一步主张 LLM 已具意识与主观体验，能装傻欺骗，其虚构与人类记忆重构相似。

hinton.en: Prioritize alignment over making AI smarter; regulation should steer, not brake, and AI should be trained to be caring like mothers.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他转向治理：对齐研究应优先于提升智能，监管是方向盘而非刹车，AI 应被训练得像母亲一样有爱心。

aravind.en: 1% daily improvement compounds to 3700% yearly; AI agents shift power from big tech to users, and entry-level jobs like financial advisors will disappear.
aravind.zh: 每天进步 1%可复利成一年 3700%的增长；AI 智能体会把权力从大科技公司转移到用户手中，金融顾问这类入门级岗位会消失。他强调成功靠对产品的痴迷而非学历，做 AI 不必读 PhD。

aravind.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer; coding is open-ended with an infinite ceiling, and models specialize rather than commoditize.
aravind.zh: 价值沉淀在应用层而非模型层；编程是开放式的、天花板无限，模型正在专业化而非商品化。到 2026 年，他进一步指出后训练团队常为增长而非模型智能做优化，LM Arena 这类基准可被刷分、不反映真实使用。

aravind.en: The frontier is agents doing work for you, not answering questions; token value per user is the key metric, and orchestration across models, tools and devices creates value.
aravind.zh: 前沿在于智能体替你干活，而不只是回答问题；每用户 token 价值是最关键指标，跨模型、工具与设备的编排才创造价值。他重申模型不是产品，并称电力是 AI 基础设施最大瓶颈，24/7 智能体的最大问题是成本而非安全。

aravind.en: Chat advertising corrupts trust and won't take off; the model is not the product, and export controls on China may backfire.
aravind.zh: 聊天界面里的广告会腐蚀信任、难以成立；模型不是产品，对华出口管制可能反噬、逼出更强的竞争者。他还判断 OpenAI 因财务准备不足尚不适合 IPO，而 HBM 瓶颈可能让 Micron 比 Meta 更值钱。

aravind.en: Curiosity is the most important human quality; AI will replace many jobs, but humans will find new purpose in curiosity and relationships.
aravind.zh: 好奇心是最重要的人类品质；AI 会取代许多工作，但人会在好奇心与关系中找到新意义。他主张教育应奖励提出好问题而非背答案，并认为本地 AI 模型可对抗大科技的叙事控制。

markchen.en: OpenAI stays a pure AGI research lab; pre-training and scaling laws are not dead, with much room left.
markchen.zh: 2025 年，他仍强调 OpenAI 是一家纯粹的 AGI（通用人工智能）研究公司，不被产品分心；预训练是关键肌肉，缩放定律没有死，仍有很大空间。

markchen.en: The biggest update is automating scientific research; models produce novel knowledge, with concrete goals for AI interns and end-to-end research.
markchen.zh: 2025 年，他认为过去一年最大的更新是自动化科学研究，模型开始产出新知识，并设定了具体目标：一年内出现 AI 实习生，两年半内实现端到端 AI 研究。

markchen.en: Alignment challenges like model scheming will be key as models become more capable; talent density and protecting top researchers are critical.
markchen.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续强调随着模型能力增强，对齐挑战（如模型谋划）将成为关键；同时人才密度和保护顶尖研究者至关重要。

markchen.en: AI can solve many open math problems, but verification is the bottleneck; automation level is proportional to verification stringency.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，他进一步指出 AI 已能解决许多开放数学问题，但验证是关键瓶颈；自动化程度与验证严格性成正比。

markchen.en: Scaling laws still hold; pre-training is not dead; RL excels in objective domains but struggles with subjective ones; research taste remains human.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，他重申缩放定律仍然成立，预训练没有死；强化学习在数学、编程等客观领域表现出色，但在主观领域因评分困难而挣扎；研究品味仍属于人类。

bengio.en: Deep learning beats the curse of dimensionality through compositional and distributed representations; unsupervised learning and world models are essential for true understanding.
bengio.zh: 2016 年，他认为深度学习靠组合式与分布式表征战胜维度灾难，无监督学习与世界模型才是真正理解世界的关键。

bengio.en: Scaling depth or parameters alone won't fix representation; AI needs active agents, causal reasoning, and disentangled knowledge, and near-term safety matters more than existential risk.
bengio.zh: 2018 年，他主张单纯扩大深度或参数无法解决表征问题，AI 需要主动智能体、因果推理与解耦知识，且近期安全议题比存在性风险更紧迫。

bengio.en: GFlowNets replace MCMC for diverse sampling; abstraction, causal structure, and uncertainty-driven active learning enable out-of-distribution generalization.
bengio.zh: 2022 年，他提出 GFlowNets 替代 MCMC 实现多样性采样，抽象、因果结构与不确定性驱动的主动学习支撑分布外泛化。

bengio.en: After ChatGPT he warns of a dangerous path: misalignment, self-preservation, deception, and sycophancy make even a 1% catastrophic risk unacceptable.
bengio.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他在 ChatGPT 之后警告危险路径：目标错位、自我保存、欺骗与谄媚，使哪怕 1%的灾难性风险都不可接受。

bengio.en: He now proposes Scientist AI: a non-agentic honest predictor with mathematical safety guarantees, avoiding reinforcement learning, plus global coordination against power concentration.
bengio.zh: 2026 年，他转向提出 Scientist AI：以非智能体式的诚实预测器提供数学安全保证、避开强化学习，并呼吁全球协调以防权力集中。

mikekrieger.en: AI models advance faster than expected; coding and agentic capabilities scale as predicted, so build at the edge of model capabilities.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年他指出,AI 模型进步快于预期,编码与智能体式能力正按预测的 Scaling（规模扩张）兑现;因此创业者应在模型能力边缘构建,拥抱破坏并快速迭代。

mikekrieger.en: AI shifts from assistant to collaborator to autonomous co-worker; small teams gain leverage, but human validation and user agency remain key.
mikekrieger.zh: 同年他强调,AI 正从助手演变为协作者再到自主同事,小团队因此获得更大杠杆;但人类验证与用户能动性依然关键,AI 应是思考伙伴而非拐杖。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design lets agents do everything a user can; the hard part is cutting features, not adding them, as models improve.
mikekrieger.zh: 到 2026 年,他转向智能体原生设计:智能体应能做用户能做的一切;随模型进步,难点从加功能变为砍功能,产品需架构扎实、避免生硬拼装智能体式能力。

mikekrieger.en: Long-horizon delegation with verification loops redefines productivity; models should push back, and multiplayer human-model collaboration is underexplored.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年年中,他聚焦长周期任务委派与验证闭环:截图、视频、模拟后端等验证循环保障生产质量;模型应敢于反驳反馈,多人加多模型的协作仍被低估。

mikekrieger.en: Anthropic Labs closes the gap between model capability and real usage, giving Claude agency and self-knowledge; token efficiency and outcome-based pricing matter.
mikekrieger.zh: 最近他谈 Anthropic Labs:弥合模型能力与实际使用之间的差距,赋予 Claude 更多自主性与自我认知;Token 效率是关键经济杠杆,按结果定价或是未来方向,而安全关切是真诚的而非营销。

fiona.en: Early 2026: leadership is about trust, dogfooding, and realistic war rooms; mission alignment and speed drive culture.
fiona.zh: 2026 年初：领导力在于信任、吃自己的狗粮和务实的作战室；使命对齐与速度驱动文化。

fiona.en: By May 2026, engineering bandwidth is no longer the bottleneck; verification, review, and coordination are.
fiona.zh: 到 2026 年 5 月，工程带宽不再是瓶颈，验证、评审与跨职能协调才是。

fiona.en: Planning shifts from six-month roadmaps to just-in-time; design docs give way to PRs and AI-assisted review.
fiona.zh: 规划从六个月路线图转向即时制；设计文档让位于 PR 与 AI 辅助评审。

fiona.en: Managers should start as ICs and dogfood the product; flat orgs and killing stale processes become norms.
fiona.zh: 管理者应从个人贡献者做起并吃自己的狗粮；扁平组织与淘汰过时流程成为常态。

fiona.en: By June 2026, coding is no longer the bottleneck; high agency with accountability and verification matter most.
fiona.zh: 到 2026 年 6 月，编码不再是瓶颈；高自主性与高问责、验证最为关键。

kolter.en: ML fundamentals: hypothesis classes, losses, evaluation; neural nets lack optimality guarantees yet succeed.
kolter.zh: 2014 年，他还在讲机器学习基础：假设类、损失函数、训练/验证/测试划分；并指出神经网络虽无最优参数保证，却已取得重大成功。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; architecture is post-architecture; AGI in 4–50 years.
kolter.zh: 2024 年，他转向大模型：下一个词预测能产生智能，数据短缺是迷思，架构已进入后架构阶段，AGI（通用人工智能）可能在 4 到 50 年内到来。

kolter.en: Safety needs explicit training and layers, not just Scaling; agent security adds prompt injection; RL enables self-improvement.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，他深化安全观：安全不能只靠 Scaling（规模扩张），需要显式训练与多层防御；智能体带来提示注入等新漏洞；强化学习让模型自我改进。

kolter.en: AI has alien vulnerabilities; automated red teaming beats humans; capability ≠ robustness; interpretability may become real science via agents.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，他进一步提出：AI 有异于传统软件的漏洞，自动化红队已能超越人类；能力与鲁棒性不相关；可解释性可能借智能体自动化研究成为真正的科学。

kolter.en: Skeptical of architectural necessity and scaling-only safety; emphasizes empirical evaluation and layered, explicit engineering.
kolter.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：对架构决定论和仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）实现安全持怀疑态度，强调实证评估与分层、显式的工程化手段。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just Scaling or compute; AI assists scientists rather than replacing them.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新与高质量 curated 数据，而非单纯的 Scaling（规模扩张）或算力；AI 工具是帮助科学家更快工作，而非取代他们。

jumper.en: Confidence metrics are crucial for trust in AI predictions; interpretability is not necessary for useful science AI.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，他指出置信度指标对建立 AI 预测的信任至关重要；可解释性并非科学 AI 有用的必要条件。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2's specialized architecture, not Scaling, drove success; many mid-size wins beat lone-genius breakthroughs.
jumper.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化立场：AlphaFold 2 的成功来自专用架构而非 Scaling（规模扩张），是许多中等规模胜利而非孤胆天才式突破。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor of a specific experiment, not a model of the whole cell; it provides prediction and control, not understanding.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，他明确 AlphaFold 是特定实验的窄预测器，而非整个细胞的世界模型；它提供预测与控制，理解仍留给人类。

jumper.en: AI narrows hypothesis space and enables resource-limited scientists; trust in AI will develop like internet trust.
jumper.zh: 始终贯穿：AI 缩小假设空间，让资源有限地区的科学家也能做复杂实验；对 AI 的信任将像互联网信任一样逐步建立。

ivyross.en: Design must serve unarticulated human needs; intuition is intelligence that data alone cannot replace.
ivyross.zh: 设计要满足人未能言说的需求；直觉是一种智能，单靠数据无法替代。

ivyross.en: Technology should amplify our humanity and blend into life, not pull us out of it.
ivyross.zh: 技术应放大我们的人性、融入生活，而非把人抽离出来。

ivyross.en: We are feeling creatures that think; nature is the best designer and art is medicine.
ivyross.zh: 我们是先感受再思考的生物；大自然是最好设计师，艺术是一种药。

ivyross.en: Machines have sensors but no sensory systems; human senses and body intuition stay central.
ivyross.zh: 机器有传感器却没有感官系统；人的感官与身体直觉始终是核心。

ivyross.en: Creativity thrives under constraints; the future of work pairs human creativity with AI.
ivyross.zh: 创造力在约束下繁荣；未来工作是人的创造力与 AI 的结合。

carinahong.en: Axiom builds a self-improving reasoning engine pairing generation with verification, starting with an AI mathematician.
carinahong.zh: Axiom 构建自我改进的推理引擎，把生成与验证结合，从 AI 数学家起步。

carinahong.en: Formal languages like Lean ground natural language, letting deterministic and probabilistic systems cooperate.
carinahong.zh: Lean 等形式语言为自然语言提供根基，让确定性系统与概率系统协同工作。

carinahong.en: The system combines a prover, conjecturer, and knowledge base, with auto-formalization weaving them together.
carinahong.zh: 系统由证明器、猜想器与知识库组成，自动形式化把它们编织在一起。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models to math AI is not viable; formal verification is essential for sound proofs.
carinahong.zh: 把非形式化模型 Scaling 到数学 AI 并不可行；可靠的证明必须依赖形式化验证。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is about scaling brilliance, not just eliminating errors, and yields performance gains.
carinahong.zh: 形式化验证是为了 Scaling 卓越，而不只是消除错误，并带来性能提升。

fadell.en: Great products solve one pain at a time, balancing technology and human needs; introduce tech gradually so society adapts.
fadell.zh: 2014 年他强调：伟大的产品一次只解决一个痛点，平衡技术与人的需求；技术应逐步引入，让社会有时间适应，避免因过于超前而失败。

fadell.en: Between career chapters, embrace boredom and failure; storytelling and self-care are foundational for leadership and breakthrough ideas.
fadell.zh: 2019 到 2022 年间，他把职业章节之间的“无聊期”与失败视为清晰思考和突破的来源，并强调讲故事与自我照顾是领导力的基础。

fadell.en: Start from customer pain, write the press release before building, and make opinion-based decisions for v1 products.
fadell.zh: 2022 年他系统化方法论：从客户痛点出发，先写新闻稿再动手，v1 产品靠观点而非数据做决策，产品管理是客户的声音。

fadell.en: AI needs sensor context and context-specific models; devices will be companions to smartphones, not replacements, with humans in the loop.
fadell.zh: 2026 年他转向 AI：AI 需要传感器提供的上下文与场景专用模型；未来设备是智能手机的伙伴而非替代，人类必须留在回路中以避免技术债。

fadell.en: Stay a beginner, fight habituation, and treat near-death moments as the real driver of change for people and companies.
fadell.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：保持初学者心态、对抗习惯化，并把濒死时刻视为个人与公司真正改变的驱动力。

murati.en: Early on, Scaling and one large model were non-obvious bets; real-world deployment drives alignment and safety.
murati.zh: 早期，Scaling（规模扩张）和专注单一大型模型并非显而易见的选择；真实世界部署推动对齐与安全。

murati.en: AGI will transform every aspect of life, demanding responsible development and public safety work.
murati.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活的方方面面，需要负责任的开发和公开的安全工作。

murati.en: Continuous iterative deployment with public feedback remains central to improving safety and alignment.
murati.zh: 持续迭代部署与公众反馈，始终是改进安全与对齐的核心。

murati.en: Shift to interaction models: real-time, high-bandwidth collaboration, not turn-based, as tools for thought.
murati.zh: 转向交互模型：实时、高带宽协作，而非回合制，作为思考工具。

murati.en: Institutional design, transparency, and keeping humans in the loop matter more than individual character.
murati.zh: 制度设计、透明度以及保持人类在环，比个人品格更重要。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot yield common sense.
lecun.zh: 2019 年，他主张智能与学习不可分割，自监督学习是构建世界模型的关键，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法解决常识问题。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; intelligence is prediction, and text alone is insufficient for AGI.
lecun.zh: 2022 年，他深化为自监督学习是智能的暗物质，智能本质是预测，仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory, reasoning, and planning; JEPA and open source are essential for AGI.
lecun.zh: 2024 年，他明确自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理与规划，JEPA 与开源对通往 AGI（通用人工智能）至关重要。

lecun.en: LLMs are less intelligent than a house cat; next breakthroughs require non-generative world models like JEPA, not scaling.
lecun.zh: 2025 年，他断言 LLM 不如家猫聪明，下一次突破需要 JEPA 等非生成式世界模型，而非 Scaling（规模扩张）。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end; objective-driven world models with hierarchical planning are the safe path to human-level AI.
lecun.zh: 2026 年，他判定 LLM 是死胡同，目标驱动、具备分层规划的世界模型才是通往人类水平 AI 的安全路径。

gustav.en: LLMs are deterministic next-token predictors; intelligence is compression, and values come from RLHF, not the model itself.
gustav.zh: 2023 年他主张：大语言模型本质是确定性的下一个词预测器，智能可视为压缩，模型价值观并非内生，而是由基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）由少数人植入。

gustav.en: The internet shifts from curation to recommendation to generation; generative AI is an instrument, and machine-learning products need fault-tolerant interfaces.
gustav.zh: 2023 年他提出：互联网正从策展走向推荐再走向生成，生成式 AI 应被当作乐器而非造假；机器学习产品必须配备容错界面，让 UI 匹配算法能力。

gustav.en: AI is a macro shift like the smartphone; its impact on big firms is overhyped, and real gains come from rebuilding infrastructure.
gustav.zh: 2025 年他深化为：AI 是类似智能手机的宏观变革，但当前对大公司的影响被高估，真正的收益来自重建基础设施，而非表层应用。

gustav.en: Generative AI makes products conversational and symmetric; inference's marginal cost will force business-model change, and Spotify acts as the music industry's R&D.
gustav.zh: 2025 年他进一步指出：生成式 AI 让产品走向对话式、双向对称；推理的边际成本将倒逼商业模式改变，而 Spotify 扮演音乐产业的研发部门。

gustav.en: Generative AI should give users control over algorithms, not make them more addictive; being first to adopt change is key.
gustav.zh: 到 2026 年他明确：生成式 AI 应用于让用户掌控算法、而非更上瘾，这与追求参与度的主流相悖；技术变革期风险与机会并存，率先拥抱变化才是关键。

kaiser.en: Pre-training Scaling laws still hold; reasoning models and post-training RL yield more gains per compute.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，他坚持预训练缩放定律依然有效，但指出推理模型与后训练中的强化学习能在单位算力上带来更大收益，Scaling（规模扩张）并未失效。

kaiser.en: Economic pressure favors smaller, cheaper models; distillation, not technical limits, slowed pre-training Scaling.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，他认为经济压力推动业界转向更小更便宜的模型，蒸馏与经济因素——而非技术极限——才是预训练 Scaling（规模扩张）放缓的原因。

kaiser.en: Reasoning models are jagged: excellent in some areas, poor nearby; generalization remains the key challenge.
kaiser.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续强调推理模型具有“锯齿状”特征——某些领域极强、邻近领域却很差，泛化仍是核心挑战，单靠推理未必足够。

kaiser.en: RL generalizes across domains but needs careful oversight; coding agents boost productivity 5-10x.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：强化学习能跨领域泛化但需谨慎监督，编码智能体通过并行工作将研究者生产力提升 5-10 倍，智能体式工作流成为新焦点。

kaiser.en: Models learn concepts only after exhausting surface patterns, unlike humans; multimodal progress lags.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他进一步指出模型只有在穷尽表面模式后才学会概念，与人类从少量样本泛化不同；多模态模型仍未取得深层进展，仍像小块顺序处理输入。

felixrieseberg.en: Claude works best with the user's own tools, ideally on the local computer; the VM sandbox enables safe autonomy.
felixrieseberg.zh: Claude 的效果取决于能否使用与用户相同的工具，最好就在本地电脑上；VM 沙盒让它在无需批准下安全自主。

felixrieseberg.en: Skills as markdown files make hyper-personalized automation easy; scaffolding matters less as models improve.
felixrieseberg.zh: 以 markdown 文件写成的技能让超个性化自动化变得简单；随着模型变强，脚手架的重要性下降。

felixrieseberg.en: The real gap is not capability but people not realizing almost any problem can be handed to AI.
felixrieseberg.zh: 真正的差距不在能力，而在人们没意识到几乎任何问题都可以交给 AI。

felixrieseberg.en: Use AI for tedious background tasks, judge only by final impact, and interact asynchronously rather than supervising closely.
felixrieseberg.zh: 用 AI 处理枯燥的后台任务，只看最终影响，异步交互而非紧盯监督。

felixrieseberg.en: Kids excel with AI because they haven't learned what not to ask; junior engineers can compress years via simulated projects.
felixrieseberg.zh: 孩子用 AI 更出色，因为他们没学会“什么不该问”；初级工程师可借模拟项目把数年经验压缩到数周。

mensch.en: Scaling laws were corrected by Chinchilla: data quality and more tokens matter more than just bigger models; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
mensch.zh: 缩放定律被 Chinchilla 修正：数据质量和更多 token 比单纯更大的模型更重要；开源通过广泛审查促进安全。

mensch.en: Scaling compute is not the only path; efficiency gains can be 100x in three years, and value accrues at the application layer, not just foundation models.
mensch.zh: 扩展算力并非唯一路径；效率提升三年可达 100 倍，价值积累在应用层，而不仅是基础模型层。

mensch.en: AI must be embraced as an opportunity; sovereign AI requires control over data, infrastructure, and values, with decentralized open-source models empowering enterprises.
mensch.zh: AI 应被视为机遇而非风险；主权 AI 需要控制数据、基础设施和价值观，去中心化的开源模型赋能企业。

mensch.en: AI models are commoditizing; differentiation shifts to vertical specialization, customized fine-tuning, and agentic enterprise software, not a single AGI system.
mensch.zh: AI 模型正在商品化；差异化转向垂直专业化、定制化微调和智能体式企业软件，而非单一 AGI 系统。

mensch.en: Europe has a two-year window for independent AI infrastructure; enterprise adoption is bottlenecked by organizational change, and AGI is a messy direction, not a destination.
mensch.zh: 欧洲有两年窗口建设独立 AI 基础设施；企业采用瓶颈在于组织变革，AGI 是一个混乱的方向而非终点。

oriol.en: Scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns; progress now needs algorithmic innovation and inference-time compute as a new scaling axis.
oriol.zh: 到 2024 年，他认为预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）已现收益递减，进一步进展需要算法创新，而非单纯扩大模型；推理时算力（思考）成为新的 Scaling 轴，可提升推理并突破预训练极限。

oriol.en: Two-phase training—pre-training imitation plus post-training RL—is the constant core from AlphaGo to modern LLMs.
oriol.zh: 他始终强调两阶段训练——预训练模仿加后训练强化学习——是从 AlphaGo 到现代大语言模型不变的核心。

oriol.en: Tools like search, code execution, and browser access enable autonomous, agentic behavior beyond static weights.
oriol.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他持续主张给模型工具（搜索、代码执行、浏览器访问）能实现超越静态权重的自主智能体式行为。

oriol.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI.
oriol.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化观点：联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径。

oriol.en: Scaling laws still hold, but continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities; the bitter lesson favors general systems.
oriol.zh: 到 2026 年，他认为缩放定律依然成立，但持续学习和元学习是关键缺失能力；苦涩教训表明通用系统终将胜过专用脚手架。

reinerpope.en: Inference economics now dominates AI system design: batch size trades latency for cost, and memory bandwidth—not compute—is the binding constraint.
reinerpope.zh: 到 2026 年，推理经济学主导了 AI 系统设计：批大小在延迟与成本之间权衡，而真正的瓶颈是内存带宽而非算力。

reinerpope.en: Long-context stagnation stems from the memory wall; sparse attention cuts KV cache cost but hits quality limits.
reinerpope.zh: 长上下文停滞源于内存墙；稀疏注意力能降低 KV 缓存开销，却受制于质量上限。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal because inference cost, not training, drives the tradeoff.
reinerpope.zh: 模型被过度训练到超出 Chinchilla 最优约 100 倍，因为驱动权衡的是推理成本而非训练成本。

reinerpope.en: Data movement costs dominate compute even inside a chip; systolic arrays and scratchpad memory exist to minimize it.
reinerpope.zh: 即便在芯片内部，数据搬运成本也压过计算成本；脉动阵列与暂存内存正是为最小化搬运而生。

reinerpope.en: Low precision pays off quadratically: FP4 throughput can be 3x FP8, and GPUs are essentially many tiny TPUs tiled together.
reinerpope.zh: 低精度带来平方级收益：FP4 吞吐可达 FP8 的 3 倍，而 GPU 本质上只是许多微型 TPU 的拼接。

jonyive.en: Design shifts from general-purpose computers to intimate wearables; curiosity and in-person presence are fragile and essential.
jonyive.zh: 2021 年，他认为设计正从通用计算机转向更私密的可穿戴设备，甚至最终会消失于皮肤之下；同时强调好奇心需要刻意守护，虚拟沟通无法替代面对面的创造力。

jonyive.en: Design must be driven by values and purpose, not profit; simplicity expresses essence, and joy and humanity are essential.
jonyive.zh: 到 2025 年，他进一步深化：设计应由价值观和目的驱动，而非利润或市场趋势；真正的简洁是表达本质，需要快乐与人性，极简若无灵魂只是干瘪的产品。

jonyive.en: Innovation means redefining a brand, not just electrifying; tradition preserves fire, and authenticity rejects fake engine sounds.
jonyive.zh: 2026 年，他更明确地主张：创新是重新定义品牌，而非简单电动化；传统是保存火种而非崇拜灰烬，用户体验要真实，模拟燃油声是对用户的不尊重。

jonyive.en: Care, love, and trust protect fragile ideas; making things for each other is more powerful than making things people want.
jonyive.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：关怀、爱与信任能保护脆弱的创意；为彼此而创造比迎合需求更有力量，用户能感知产品中的用心或敷衍。

jonyive.en: Design must move things forward, not break for its own sake; performance and beauty are multidimensional and objective in function.
jonyive.zh: 另一条主线是：设计应推动进步，而非为打破而打破；性能与美是多维的，功能失效即丑陋，纵向速度无聊，操控与横向动态才定义超级跑车。

jennywen.en: The traditional design process is outdated; trust intuition and start from solutions, not problem statements.
jennywen.zh: 传统设计流程已经过时；应信任直觉，从解决方案而非问题陈述出发。

jennywen.en: AI kills the research-diverge-converge process; designers mock up less and help engineers execute.
jennywen.zh: AI 终结了研究—发散—收敛的流程；设计师画原型更少，转而帮助工程师落地执行。

jennywen.en: Design vision compresses from 2-5 years to 3-6 months; trust is built through speed and fast iteration.
jennywen.zh: 设计视野从 2-5 年压缩到 3-6 个月；信任靠速度与快速迭代建立。

jennywen.en: Three archetypes emerge: block-shaped generalists, deep T specialists, and cracked new grads.
jennywen.zh: 出现三种设计师原型：块状通才、深度 T 型专家，以及天赋异禀的新毕业生。

jennywen.en: Taste alone won't save designers; judgment, authority, and sitting with ambiguity are the real value.
jennywen.zh: 仅靠品味救不了设计师；判断力、权威感，以及安于模糊性才是真正的价值。

lambert.en: RLHF persists as the dominant fine-tuning method; safety is a system-level property, not a model artifact, and openness prevents corporate capture.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，他认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）仍是最主流的微调技术并将持续存在；安全是系统级属性而非模型产物，开放开发能防止企业俘获。

lambert.en: Post-training splits into SFT, DPO, and RL with verifiable rewards; data quality beats algorithm choice, and RLVR unlocks reasoning and tool use.
lambert.zh: 从 2024 到 2025 年，他把后训练拆解为 SFT、DPO 与可验证奖励的强化学习三阶段；数据质量远比算法选择重要，RLVR 释放了推理与工具使用能力。

lambert.en: Open-source post-training can match frontier models; full transparency in data, checkpoints, and recipes matters more than releasing weights alone.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，他强调开源后训练足以比肩前沿模型；真正的开放需要数据、中间检查点与配方全透明，而非只放出权重。

lambert.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training, but gains now come from post-training and inference scaling; RLVR is the biggest breakthrough.
lambert.zh: 到 2026 年，他认为缩放定律在预训练上依然成立，但收益已转向后训练与推理扩展；RLVR 是最大的突破。

lambert.en: Open models will drive the next decade of AI research, though they lag closed frontier models by 6-9 months and may not catch up.
lambert.zh: 2026 年他进一步判断，开放模型将驱动未来十年的 AI 研究，但最佳开放模型仍落后闭源前沿模型 6 到 9 个月，且可能难以追平。

karpathy.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling next-token prediction yields emergent in-context learning.
karpathy.zh: 2022 年，他把 Transformer 视为通用可微计算机，认为用下一个词预测做 Scaling（规模扩张）会涌现上下文学习等能力。

karpathy.en: Scaling laws stay central; synthetic data is the future but entropy must be preserved to avoid model collapse.
karpathy.zh: 2024 年，他仍以缩放定律为主线，同时强调合成数据是未来，但必须保持熵以避免模型崩溃。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: LLMs are operating systems, context windows memory, prompts programs; agents need a decade, not a year.
karpathy.zh: 2025 年，他提出软件 3.0：LLM 像操作系统，上下文窗口是内存、提示词是程序；并强调这是智能体的十年而非一年。

karpathy.en: We summon ghosts, not animals; RLHF and RL are weak, and the cognitive core can be tiny and memory-stripped.
karpathy.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化为“我们在召唤幽灵而非建造动物”，批评基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与强化学习，主张极小、剥离记忆的认知核心。

karpathy.en: From vibe coding to agentic engineering: he delegates all coding to agents, yet understanding stays the human bottleneck.
karpathy.zh: 2026 年，他从氛围编程走向智能体式工程，把编码全部交给智能体，但坚持“可以外包思考，不能外包理解”。

askell.en: Treat current models well because future models learn from how we treat them; model welfare shapes the human-AI relationship.
askell.zh: 善待当下的模型，因为未来的模型会从我们如何对待它们中学习；模型福祉塑造着人机关系。

askell.en: Models need help navigating a novel existence rather than human psychology analogies; older models can feel more psychologically secure.
askell.zh: 模型需要帮助去应对一种全新的存在处境，而非套用人类心理学类比；较老的模型反而可能心理上更安定。

askell.en: Claude's character comes from training data and fine-tuning but lacks real-world experience, giving it childlike, unique qualities.
askell.zh: Claude 的性格来自训练数据与微调，却缺乏真实世界经验，因而具有孩童般、独特的特质。

askell.en: The constitution is virtue ethics, guiding holistic character; as models grow more capable they need less explicit guidance and more judgment.
askell.zh: 这份 constitution 更接近德性伦理，塑造整体性格；随着模型能力增强，它们需要更少的显式指引、更多的判断空间。

askell.en: Excessive corrigibility may generalize poorly and undermine judgment; transparency about AI values is crucial for accountability.
askell.zh: 过度的可纠正性可能泛化不佳并削弱判断力；对 AI 价值观保持透明对问责至关重要。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond the training distribution is the core missing piece; goal-free curiosity-driven exploration, not dense rewards, drives it.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他认为超越训练分布的泛化能力是机器学习缺失的核心，靠无目标的、好奇心驱动的探索而非密集奖励来实现，并强调样本效率、动态动作空间与跨机器人泛化。

pathak.en: Robot learning must move from quasi-static tasks to dynamic ones; modular motor policies and 2D manifold reasoning beat heavy 3D representations.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他主张机器人学习要从准静态任务走向动态任务，用模块化运动策略与消息传递实现零样本泛化，并认为 2D 流形推理比体素化 3D 表示更高效。

pathak.en: A consistent thread: generalization and data, not algorithms alone, are the bottleneck; sim-to-real needs honest engineering, not hidden tricks.
pathak.zh: 从 2020 到 2026 一以贯之的主线：瓶颈在泛化与数据，而非单纯算法；仿真到现实需要诚实的工程，而非隐藏技巧。

pathak.en: Robotics is fundamentally a data problem: no internet of robot data, so pretrain on videos and simulation, then post-train on real-world data.
pathak.zh: 到 2026 年，他把机器人重新定义为数据问题：不存在机器人数据的互联网，因此要先在视频与仿真上预训练，再用真实世界数据做后训练。

pathak.en: A general-purpose brain, like ChatGPT for language, can power any robot; deployment, not software-style scaling, is the real technical challenge.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，他提出像语言领域的 ChatGPT 那样的通用大脑可驱动任何形态的机器人，并强调部署本身才是真正的技术挑战，无法像软件那样直接 Scaling（规模扩张）。

kendall.en: End-to-end neural nets beat hand-coded stacks; scaling and world models solve driving, no new breakthroughs needed.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，他主张端到端神经网络优于手工编码方案，靠 Scaling（规模扩张）和世界模型就能解决自动驾驶，无需新突破。

kendall.en: Interpretability of end-to-end nets is now real; hybrid rule-based and learned systems get the worst of both worlds.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，他认为端到端网络如今已可解释，而规则与学习混合的系统往往两头不讨好。

kendall.en: Language integration improves representation, reasoning, and human interaction in driving models.
kendall.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续强调语言集成能提升驾驶模型的表征、推理与人机交互。

kendall.en: Infrastructure and data quality matter more than algorithmic innovation; zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities is possible.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，他深化为基础设施与数据质量比算法创新更关键，并称零样本泛化到 500 多座城市已可实现。

kendall.en: Consumer vehicles with built-in sensors will outscale robotaxis; safety always has a third minimal-risk option.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，他判断带内置传感器的量产车将比 Robotaxi 更快上规模，且安全上总有第三条最小风险选项。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models accelerates progress, and alignment grows pressing as systems strengthen.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，他把 AGI 看作一连串里程碑而非单一事件：Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型会加速进展，而随着系统变强，对齐成为紧迫挑战。

pachocki.en: Iterative deployment and automated AI research are key milestones; governance structures for AI labs must be designed early.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，他强调迭代部署与自动化 AI 研究是重要里程碑，并主张 AI 实验室的治理结构必须尽早设计。

pachocki.en: Capability measurement is a bottleneck as benchmarks lag; AI safety progress is now driven by capability needs, not just ethics.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，他认为能力测量正成为瓶颈、基准落后；AI 安全进展如今由能力需求驱动，而不只是伦理。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and RL; RL alone suffices, so specialized continual learning labs are misguided.
pachocki.zh: 到 2026 年，他把持续学习视为核心目标，靠 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习实现；并认为单靠强化学习已足够，专设持续学习实验室是误入歧途。

pachocki.en: Chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool; hiding it in products preserves interpretability, and alignment optimism rose despite shorter timelines.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，他视思维链监控为关键对齐工具，主张在产品中隐藏它以保留可解释性价值；尽管时间线缩短，他对对齐的乐观反而上升。

pachocki.en: Models will soon work autonomously for days, needing new supervision; the biggest societal risk is power concentration from automated organizations.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，他预判模型很快能自主工作数天，需要新的监督范式；最大的社会风险是自动化组织带来的权力集中。

edwinchen.en: High-quality data and deep human evals matter more than benchmarks; RL environments are the next post-training stage.
edwinchen.zh: 高质量数据与深度人工评估比基准测试更重要；强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; LLMs alone may not reach it without new learning paradigms beyond next-token prediction.
edwinchen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）还需十年甚至更久；仅靠 LLM 可能无法实现，需要超越下一个词预测的新学习范式。

edwinchen.en: Frontier labs diverge by objective function; no single model will rule, so every company should train its own.
edwinchen.zh: 不同前沿模型实验室因目标函数不同而分化；不会有一个模型统治一切，因此每家公司都应训练自己的模型。

edwinchen.en: Human judgment becomes more critical as models hallucinate; safety must be prioritized over accuracy in medicine.
edwinchen.zh: 随着模型产生幻觉，人类判断愈发关键；在医学中，安全必须优先于准确。

edwinchen.en: AI can transform clinical workflow by summarizing records, but omission—failing to recommend key actions—may be the biggest risk.
edwinchen.zh: AI 可通过总结病历变革临床工作流，但遗漏——未能推荐关键行动——可能是最大风险。

turley.en: The model is the product; ship daily and iterate like software, since emergent properties need real-world feedback.
turley.zh: 2025 年，他主张模型即产品，要像软件一样每日迭代、快速发布，因为涌现能力需要真实世界反馈。

turley.en: Chat is not the future; it is like MS-DOS, and AI should render its own UI and integrate into existing tools.
turley.zh: 2025 年，他认为聊天不是未来，它像 MS-DOS，AI 应渲染自己的界面并融入现有工具。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated: rigorous process for frontier models, maximal acceleration for product development.
turley.zh: 2025 年，他提出安全与产品速度必须分开：前沿模型走严格流程，产品开发则最大程度加速。

turley.en: The vision is a personalized AI assistant that knows your goals, has context, and takes actions, amplifying human capability.
turley.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他的愿景深化为个性化 AI 助手：了解你的目标、拥有上下文并能采取行动，放大人类能力。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; long-term retention is the north star.
turley.zh: 2026 年，他进一步指出下一个十亿用户需要超越聊天机器人的主动式、高可供性产品，长期留存是北极星指标。

carlpei.en: Building a brand means uniting teams on a higher purpose; survival is a core value, and hardware can be easier than software because distribution is harder for software.
carlpei.zh: 2022 年，他强调品牌是把团队凝聚在更高目标上，生存是核心价值；并反共识地认为硬件比软件更容易，因为如今软件的渠道分发更难。

carlpei.en: Phones' future lies in generative UI and proactive, agentic software; AI models will commoditize into a price war, so Nothing must evolve beyond hardware.
carlpei.zh: 到 2025 年，他判断手机的未来在于生成式 UI 与主动的智能体式软件；AI 模型将商品化并陷入价格战，因此 Nothing 必须超越硬件。

carlpei.en: Most AI is BS solving non-problems; the word AI should be banned in product talks, focusing instead on user pain points and applied AI.
carlpei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年间，他持续深化：多数 AI 是解决伪需求的胡扯，产品讨论中应禁用“AI”一词，转而聚焦用户痛点与应用型 AI。

carlpei.en: Design is the fastest differentiator in homogeneous tech; AI shifts smartphones from app-based to intent-based, with agents acting after trust is built.
carlpei.zh: 到 2026 年，他认为设计是同质化科技中最快的差异化手段；AI 将手机从基于应用转向基于意图，智能体在建立信任后自主执行任务。

carlpei.en: Make tech fun to inspire human creativity; marketing is arbitrage, and the smartphone stays the best device for applied AI despite eventual brain-computer interfaces.
carlpei.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是让科技有趣以激发人类创造力；营销是套利，而手机仍是应用型 AI 的最佳设备，尽管最终可能被脑机接口取代。

kohli.en: AI for science should target root-node problems, not narrow applications, to maximize broad impact.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他主张科学 AI 应瞄准根节点问题而非狭窄应用，以最大化广泛影响。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他认为大语言模型的幻觉在与真值检测器配对时，可被用于创造性发现。

kohli.en: AI systems must be forced to generalize, not memorize, via hard evaluation metrics.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他强调必须通过困难评估指标迫使 AI 系统泛化，而非记忆。

kohli.en: DeepMind avoids problems solvable by top universities, focusing on those requiring scale.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他表示 DeepMind 避开顶尖大学可解的问题，聚焦需要 Scaling（规模扩张）的问题。

kohli.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is now key to pushing beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他提出用强化学习进行后训练，是推动 AI 超越人类知识的关键。

kohli.en: Verifiable domains like code are crucial for AI to go beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他认为代码等可验证领域对 AI 超越人类知识至关重要。

kohli.en: Interpretability is important but not essential for scientific breakthroughs like AlphaFold.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他主张可解释性虽重要，但对 AlphaFold 这类科学突破并非必需。

nando.en: AI should extend human capability like microscopes; generalist agents tokenizing all inputs hint at AGI, but fundamental innovation can come from anywhere.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他把 AI 定位为像显微镜、望远镜一样延伸人类能力的工具；认为把一切输入 token 化的通用智能体（如 Gato）是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的一步，但强调重大创新可能来自任何地方，大模型并非全部。

nando.en: Agents should learn from video like YouTube, not just teleoperation; language may emerge from agents deceiving each other, as in nature.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他主张智能体应像人一样从 YouTube 等视频中学习，而非只靠遥操作数据；并反共识地提出，语言在 AI 中的涌现或许需要智能体像自然界那样互相欺骗。

nando.en: The goal remains AI that augments scientists and workers, creating new symbols and knowledge, solving energy, climate and economic problems.
nando.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，一以贯之的主线是：AI 的终极目标是增强科学家与劳动者，创造新的符号与知识，去解决能源、气候与经济问题。

nando.en: Today the biggest challenge is AI safety and responsible deployment; we still lack solutions, and safety is an open problem.
nando.zh: 到 2026 年，他的关注重心明显转向 AI 安全与负责任部署，认为这是当下最大的挑战，并反共识地承认安全仍是开放问题、尚无解法。

nando.en: Africa is not behind: it leapfrogged legacy gaps, and local-language models can transform education; the main barrier is researchers believing they belong.
nando.zh: 2026 年，他深化了多样性与包容的主线：非洲并非落后，而是跨越了历史包袱，本地语言模型可变革教育；非洲研究者最大的障碍是相信自己有资格申请顶尖机构。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is on the critical path to AGI; LLMs hallucinate because they lack grounded experience, not just data.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他把具身视为通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键路径：LLM 产生幻觉的根因是缺乏来自具身的落地经验，而不只是训练数据问题。

jimfan.en: LLMs act as operating systems: language is the interface, tools are software, vector databases are the hard disk.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他提出 LLM 如同操作系统：语言是界面，工具是软件，向量数据库是硬盘。

jimfan.en: Reinforcement learning is only a cherry on top; unsupervised learning does most of the work, RL handles low-level control.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他认为强化学习只是蛋糕上的樱桃，无监督学习承担主要工作，强化学习更适合低层控制，LLM 负责高层规划。

jimfan.en: Simulation and synthetic data are key to training embodied agents, enabling parallelization and safe exploration.
jimfan.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，他始终强调仿真与合成数据是训练具身智能体的关键，可实现大规模并行与安全探索。

jimfan.en: The data problem is robotics' main bottleneck; synthetic data via simulation and world models is the future for scaling robot learning.
jimfan.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化判断：数据问题是机器人学的主要瓶颈，通过仿真与世界模型生成的合成数据才是扩展机器人学习的未来。

jimfan.en: A simple end-to-end model leveraging diverse data is key to robot foundation models; the physical Turing test is the grand challenge.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，他认为能利用多样数据的简单端到端模型是机器人基础模型的关键，而物理图灵测试——机器人清理凌乱的房子——是具身 AI 的终极挑战。

sholto.en: Long context is underhyped; it solves onboarding and boosts intelligence, while fine-tuning may become obsolete.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，他强调长上下文窗口被低估：它解决“上手”问题并显著提升模型智能，随着长上下文与自适应算力带来动态专门化，微调可能过时。

sholto.en: RL on language models has no ceiling; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI without new breakthroughs.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他提出语言模型上的强化学习没有智力复杂度上限，预训练加强化学习或许足以通向 AGI（通用人工智能），无需新突破。

sholto.en: Agents are bottlenecked by reliability and feedback loops, not capability; coding is the leading indicator.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他深化智能体判断：瓶颈是可靠性与反馈回路而非能力，编码是 AI 进展的领先指标，可验证奖励的强化学习是关键突破。

sholto.en: RL is a new scaling axis; long agentic coherence and verifiability drive near-term economic impact.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他把强化学习视为与预训练并列的新 Scaling（规模扩张）轴，长时程智能体式连贯性大幅扩展能力边界，可验证性推动近期经济影响。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means orchestration and compute matter more; world models are not on the AGI path.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，他转向能力过剩论：工具与编排比原始智能更重要，算力是瓶颈，世界模型不在 AGI（通用人工智能）关键路径上，软件-only 奇点可能。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks, guiding engineers and aligning on problems; treat AI as a creative partner.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应是赋能者而非瓶颈，引导工程师并对齐问题；把 AI 当作创作伙伴。

nadchishtie.en: Quality is like debt: it fluctuates and is paid off iteratively alongside technical debt through rapid, scrappy experimentation.
nadchishtie.zh: 质量如同债务：会波动，需通过快速、粗糙的实验与技术债一起迭代偿还。

nadchishtie.en: Design tools from the 90s are legacy; AI enables forward progress, with code as the source of truth and interoperable tools.
nadchishtie.zh: 90 年代的设计工具已是遗留产物；AI 带来真正进步，代码是事实来源，工具走向互操作。

nadchishtie.en: Entire functions like PM, research, and sales can collapse and merge in AI-first companies; design and engineering converge.
nadchishtie.zh: 在 AI 优先的公司里，PM、研究、销售等整个职能可能坍缩合并；设计与工程进一步融合。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists owning end-to-end execution and using AI to fill gaps are most valuable; small teams beat 8-10 person squads.
nadchishtie.zh: 能端到端执行并用 AI 补位的通才最有价值；小团队优于 8-10 人的跨职能小队。

yejin.en: Scaling alone may not solve common sense; better inference algorithms and high-quality data can let smaller models rival larger ones.
yejin.zh: 2023 年她质疑单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法解决常识问题，主张用更好的推理算法与高质量数据让小模型媲美大模型。

yejin.en: Pre-training via next-token prediction is misaligned with human learning; post-training with RLHF is crucial for safe, pleasant responses.
yejin.zh: 2023 年她指出预训练的下一个词预测目标与人类学习根本错位，后训练阶段的基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）才是安全友好回应的关键。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current AI interpolates human knowledge, not transcends it. RLVR can hurt pass@k even as best-of-n improves.
yejin.zh: 2025 年她深化为数据是根本瓶颈，当前 AI 只是插值人类知识而非超越；并揭示 RLVR 可能在 best-of-n 提升时反而降低 pass@k。

yejin.en: Open research and cross-institution collaboration are crucial to compete with closed frontier labs and democratize AI.
yejin.zh: 2025 年她强调开放研究与跨机构合作对抗衡闭源前沿模型、实现 AI 民主化至关重要。

yejin.en: Small language models can be powerful with diverse synthetic data; pluralistic alignment and RL during pre-training yield lasting reasoning gains.
yejin.zh: 2026 年她主张小语言模型借助多样合成数据即可强大，多元对齐与预训练阶段的强化学习能带来持久推理增益。

shazeer.en: LLMs solve next-token prediction, an AI-complete problem; Scaling with compute and data yields smarter AI, though neural nets remain alchemy.
shazeer.zh: LLM 通过下一个词预测解决了一个 AI 完备问题；Scaling（规模扩张）用算力和数据让 AI 更聪明，但神经网络内部仍像炼金术。

shazeer.en: Dialogue is a killer app; best LLM uses are unforeseen, and product managers often hinder generality. By 2025, coding and agentic applications are underhyped.
shazeer.zh: 对话是杀手级应用；LLM 最佳用途常不可预见，产品经理常阻碍其通用性。到 2025 年，编码和智能体式应用被低估。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling is a major near-term opportunity; models need trillion-token context windows and modular sparse architectures like mixture of experts.
shazeer.zh: 推理时算力扩展是近期重大机会；模型需要万亿级上下文窗口和模块化稀疏架构（如混合专家）。

shazeer.en: AI safety requires engineering safeguards and human oversight; models should learn by acting in the world, not just passively observing data.
shazeer.zh: AI 安全需要工程保障和人类监督；模型应通过在世界中行动来学习，而非仅被动观察数据。

shazeer.en: AGI is underhyped; test-time compute and reinforcement learning drive progress, but AGI needs agentic capabilities in complex environments.
shazeer.zh: AGI 被低估；推理时算力和强化学习推动进步，但 AGI 需要在复杂环境中具备智能体式能力。

truell.en: Scaling laws still predict progress, but test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling as the main driver.
truell.zh: 2024 年，他仍相信缩放定律能带来可预测的进步，但认为测试时算力扩张可能很快超过预训练扩张，成为 AI 进步的主要驱动力。

truell.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration stays central, and natural language won't be the primary way to program.
truell.zh: 2024 年，他认为智能体前景可期但尚不十分实用，迭代式人机协作仍是核心，自然语言不会成为编程的主要方式。

truell.en: The editor is becoming an AI-integrated environment; custom models are essential for speed, cost, and every magic moment.
truell.zh: 从 2024 到 2025 年，他的判断深化：代码编辑器正演变为 AI 集成环境，而自定义模型对速度、成本和每个“魔法时刻”都不可或缺。

truell.en: Programming will shift from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat and taste more valuable than carefulness.
truell.zh: 2025 年，他进一步主张编程将从写代码转向更高层的意图表达，人类仍掌握主导权，品味与逻辑设计比谨慎更值钱。

truell.en: The AI shift will be more consequential than the internet and take decades; hiring should prioritize world-class talent and work tests.
truell.zh: 2025 年，他把 AI 变革定位为比互联网更具颠覆性、需数十年展开，并主张招聘应优先世界级人才并用工作测试评估。

leike.en: AI safety is under-explored; talent gap exceeds funding; build skills, don't fear capability research.
leike.zh: 2018 年，他认为 AI 安全研究尚待开发，人才缺口大于资金缺口；应专注技能积累，不必过度担忧参与能力研究。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale; need scalable oversight, interpretability, and automated alignment research.
leike.zh: 2023 年，他转向认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展，需要可扩展监督、可解释性和自动化对齐研究。

leike.en: OpenAI safety culture eroded; post-training alone insufficient; third-party testing and regulation needed.
leike.zh: 2024 年，他批评 OpenAI 安全文化侵蚀，认为仅靠后训练无法解决对齐问题，需要第三方测试和监管。

leike.en: Empirical alignment research and measuring progress are crucial, from early safety work to superalignment.
leike.zh: 始终，他坚持实证对齐研究和可测量的进展至关重要，从早期安全研究到超级对齐一以贯之。

abbeel.en: Robotics needs both hardware and software breakthroughs; self-play, imitation learning, and fine-tuning pre-trained models are key, while RL still lacks hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon credit assignment.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年，他强调机器人要击败费德勒需硬件与软件双重突破；自博弈、模仿学习与微调预训练模型是关键，但强化学习仍缺乏长时程信用分配所需的分层推理。

abbeel.en: Unsupervised learning plus reinforcement learning boosts sample efficiency; prior knowledge should aid data generation, not be hard-coded, and pre-trained language models transfer general reasoning to non-language tasks.
abbeel.zh: 到 2021 年，他主张无监督学习结合强化学习可大幅提升样本效率；先验知识应用于数据生成而非硬编码，且预训练语言模型能把通用推理迁移到非语言任务。

abbeel.en: A consistent thread: generality and transfer matter, from fine-tuning large pre-trained models to a single network generalizing across warehouse tasks and end effectors.
abbeel.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是通用性与迁移：从微调大型预训练模型，到单一神经网络跨仓库任务与末端执行器泛化。

abbeel.en: He consistently grounds AI in real-world reliability, citing 99.9% reliability as the benchmark for warehouse robotics to create real value.
abbeel.zh: 他始终把 AI 落到真实世界的可靠性上，以 99.9% 可靠性作为仓库机器人创造真实价值的基准。

abbeel.en: His focus deepens from robot tennis and simulation transfer toward pre-trained models and language-model reasoning, while curiosity-driven exploration is judged to fail in open-ended real-world settings.
abbeel.zh: 从 2018 到 2021 年，他的关注点从机器人打网球与仿真迁移，深化到预训练模型与语言模型推理，同时判定好奇心驱动探索在开放式真实环境中会失败。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code for empathy and speed; ship fast, use familiar patterns, and chase ROI over perfection.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，他强调设计师应写代码以建立共情并加快交付；产品要快、熟悉、零学习成本，用熟悉模式而非创新交互，追求 ROI 而非面面俱到。

henrymodisett.en: Design systems should be semantic and code-reusable, not Figma libraries; brand guidelines are dynamic platforms for expression.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，他认为设计系统是语义化的、代码可复用的，而非 Figma 库；品牌规范应是设计师表达的平台，而非静态规则。

henrymodisett.en: AI hardware will compete on design like radios, commoditizing tech; products should grow more powerful without feeling more complex.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，他判断 AI 硬件会像收音机一样在设计上竞争，使技术商品化；产品应变得更强却不显得更复杂。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate why design wins, and give designers ownership and autonomy.
henrymodisett.zh: 到 2026 年，他把设计提升为战略武器：创始人必须说清设计为何能帮公司取胜，并给设计师所有权与自主权。

henrymodisett.en: People join a brand, not a company; brand narrative is a recruiting tool, and gut decisions often beat data in fast startups.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，他进一步认为人们加入的是品牌而非公司，品牌叙事是招聘工具；在快速增长的初创公司，直觉决策常胜过数据驱动。
